destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.description: Kerala is a serene coastal state in Southern India, world-renowned for its emerald backwaters, sprawling tea plantations, and mist-covered hill stations. It offers a unique blend of tranquil nature and vibrant culture, where you can drift on a traditional houseboat one day and trek through spice-scented mountains the next. From the dramatic cliffs of Varkala to the colonial charm of Fort Kochi, Kerala provides a rejuvenating escape into a lush, tropical landscape.

destinations.name: Andaman
destinations.description: The Andaman Islands are a breathtaking archipelago in the Bay of Bengal, known for their pristine white-sand beaches, vibrant coral reefs, and turquoise waters. This tropical haven offers a perfect mix of colonial history at Port Blair, world-class diving at Havelock Island, and the raw, natural beauty of Neil Island's limestone formations. It is an ideal destination for those seeking a balance of high-energy water sports and tranquil sunsets under a canopy of lush rainforests.

destinations.name: Kashmir
destinations.description: A breathtaking Himalayan valley known for alpine lakes, snow peaks, and houseboats on Dal Lake. Offers a mix of adventure and cultural heritage.

destinations.name: Ladakh
destinations.description: Ladakh is a high-altitude desert in the Himalayas, characterized by its dramatic moon-like landscapes, azure alpine lakes, and ancient Buddhist monasteries. This rugged territory offers a spiritual and adventurous escape, where you can traverse some of the world's highest motorable roads and witness the stark beauty of snow-capped peaks against deep blue skies. From the iconic serenity of Pangong Tso to the double-humped camels of the Nubra Valley, Ladakh is a destination that feels truly otherworldly.

destinations.name: Sikkim
destinations.description: Sikkim is a mesmerizing mountain state in Northeast India, home to the majestic Kanchenjunga, the third-highest peak in the world. This serene sanctuary is defined by its dramatic high-altitude lakes, ancient Buddhist monasteries, and vibrant rhododendron valleys. From the bustling cultural heart of Gangtok to the pristine, snow-clad frontiers of North Sikkim, it offers a soul-stirring blend of spiritual peace and rugged adventure.

destinations.name: Spiti Valley
destinations.description: Spiti Valley is a breathtaking high-altitude cold desert in the Himalayas, acting as the "Middle Land" between India and Tibet. It is a surreal landscape of stark, barren mountains, ancient cliffside monasteries, and deep blue alpine lakes that change color with the sun. From sending a postcard from the world's highest post office to witnessing the 1,000-year-old "Ajanta of the Himalayas," Spiti offers a raw, soul-stirring adventure into one of the most remote corners of the world.

destinations.name: Uttarakhand
destinations.description: Uttarakhand is a breathtaking North Indian state nestled in the lap of the Himalayas, renowned for its spiritual towns, cascading waterfalls, and pristine hill stations. From the holy banks of the Ganges in Rishikesh to the colonial charm of Mussoorie and the serene lakes of Nainital, Uttarakhand offers the perfect blend of adventure, spirituality, and natural beauty. Whether you seek the thrill of white-water rafting, the peace of a Ganga Aarti, or the joy of a family holiday in the hills — Uttarakhand delivers it all.

destinations.name: Himachal Pradesh
destinations.description: Himachal Pradesh is a stunning Himalayan state offering everything from the colonial charm of Shimla to the adventure paradise of Manali. With its snow-capped peaks, lush valleys, ancient temples, and vibrant markets, Himachal is the quintessential Indian hill station destination. Whether it's the thrill of Solang Valley's paragliding, the serenity of Kufri's pine forests, or the old-world charm of Naggar Castle — Himachal Pradesh creates memories that last a lifetime.

destinations.name: Rajasthan
destinations.description: Rajasthan is India's most regal state — a land of magnificent palaces, golden deserts, vibrant bazaars, and timeless heritage. From the romantic lakes of Udaipur to the marble temples of Mount Abu, from the golden dunes of Jaisalmer to the pink walls of Jaipur, Rajasthan offers a royal experience unlike any other. Perfect for families seeking a blend of culture, history, and natural beauty.

destinations.name: Philippines
destinations.description: The Philippines is a tropical archipelago of 7,641 islands, home to some of the world's most beautiful white-sand beaches, electric coral reefs, and dramatic limestone karst scenery. From the UNESCO-listed Puerto Princesa Underground River and the island-hopping paradise of El Nido to the whale sharks of Cebu's Oslob, the Chocolate Hills of Bohol, and the cosmopolitan buzz of Manila, the Philippines is a destination of extraordinary diversity and warmth.

destinations.name: Thailand
destinations.description: Thailand is the ultimate Southeast Asian adventure — ancient golden temples, vibrant floating markets, ethical elephant sanctuaries, and some of the world's most stunning beaches. From the electric energy of Bangkok to the turquoise coves of Krabi and the vibrant night markets of Chiang Mai, 'The Land of Smiles' has something extraordinary for every traveller.

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.description: Bali is the Island of Gods — a sculpted volcanic landscape of emerald rice terraces, ancient sea temples, vibrant coral reefs, and a deeply spiritual Hindu culture. Whether you seek adventure on Mount Batur, serenity at Ubud's yoga retreats, or legendary nightlife at Seminyak's beach clubs, Bali delivers it all in tropical splendour.

destinations.name: Vietnam
destinations.description: Vietnam is a country of extraordinary contrasts — colonial-era old towns, towering karst landscapes, sizzling street-food scenes, and turquoise bays. From the ancient lantern-lit streets of Hoi An to the UNESCO wonder of Ha Long Bay and the buzzing alleys of Hanoi's Old Quarter, Vietnam rewards every type of traveller with something genuinely unforgettable.

destinations.name: Japan
destinations.description: Japan is a country of extraordinary contrasts — where 1,000-year-old temples stand in the shadow of neon-lit skyscrapers. Experience cherry blossoms in Kyoto, bullet trains cutting through countryside, Michelin-starred ramen stalls, the powder snows of Hokkaido, and the pop-culture tsunami of Tokyo's Akihabara district. Japan will redefine your understanding of what a destination can be.

destinations.name: South Korea
destinations.description: South Korea is a captivating blend of ancient traditions and hyper-modern innovation. Walk the streets of Seoul where centuries-old palaces stand beside K-pop boutiques and rooftop cafes, explore the haenyeo diving culture of Jeju Island, soak in the colourful lantern festivals of Gyeongju, and savour the extraordinary depth of Korean cuisine — from royal banquets to streetside tteokbokki stalls.

destinations.name: Singapore
destinations.description: Singapore is a dazzling city-state where gleaming skyscrapers, world-class theme parks, and a vibrant multicultural food scene come together in a compact, spotlessly clean package. Stroll through Gardens by the Bay under the iconic Supertrees, lose yourself in Universal Studios, explore Chinatown, Little India, and Kampong Glam, and sample everything from Michelin-starred hawker food to rooftop cocktails with a skyline view.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.description: The Maldives is the ultimate Indian Ocean escape — 1,200 coral islands scattered across an impossibly blue sea, each ringed by turquoise lagoons, powdery white sand, and vibrant coral reefs. Whether you choose an overwater bungalow in a private resort or a local island adventure on a budget, the Maldives promises sunsets, snorkelling with whale sharks, and a sense of peace that is almost impossible to describe.

destinations.name: Georgia
destinations.description: Georgia is the Caucasus' best-kept secret — a country of dramatic mountain landscapes, ancient cave cities, UNESCO-listed old towns, and some of the world's oldest wine-making traditions dating back 8,000 years. From the charming streets of Tbilisi's sulphur-bath district and the snow-capped peaks of Kazbegi to the seaside glamour of Batumi, Georgia is a destination of extraordinary beauty and depth.

destinations.name: Russia
destinations.description: Russia is the world's largest country — a land of imperial grandeur, golden-domed cathedrals, the iconic Trans-Siberian Railway, and the ethereal beauty of Lake Baikal. Marvel at the opulent palaces of St. Petersburg, explore the historic fortress of Moscow's Kremlin, and witness the breathtaking ballet at the Bolshoi Theatre. Russia's scale and cultural richness are simply unmatched anywhere on Earth.

destinations.name: Iceland
destinations.description: Iceland is where the raw power of nature is on full, dramatic display — active volcanoes, cascading waterfalls, bubbling geysers, and vast glaciers. Chase the Northern Lights in winter, drive the legendary Ring Road past lava fields and fjords, soak in geothermal hot springs, and watch puffins wheel overhead in the midnight sun of summer. Iceland is not just a destination — it's a force of nature.

destinations.name: Italy
destinations.description: Italy is a country of unparalleled beauty and culture — the birthplace of the Renaissance, home to the world's finest cuisine, and blessed with a landscape that ranges from the fashion-forward streets of Milan to the ancient grandeur of Rome, the artistic treasures of Florence, and the dreamlike canals of Venice. Italy's dolce vita philosophy permeates every aspect of life, from leisurely espresso mornings to long, laughter-filled al fresco dinners.

destinations.name: France
destinations.description: France is the world's most visited country for good reason — Paris, the City of Light, is one of humanity's greatest achievements: home to the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, Michelin-starred restaurants, and some of the world's most glamorous boutiques. Beyond Paris, the sun-kissed promenade of Nice, the lavender fields of Provence, and the wine-soaked villages of Bordeaux make France an endlessly rewarding destination.

destinations.name: Switzerland
destinations.description: Switzerland is the jewel of the Alps — a small but spectacular country of impossibly postcard-perfect landscapes, with snow-capped peaks, deep glacial lakes, chocolate-box villages, and some of Europe's finest ski resorts. Take the Glacier Express through dramatic mountain scenery, paraglide over Interlaken, marvel at the Matterhorn from Zermatt, and sample artisan cheese fondue in a mountain hut. Switzerland is the pinnacle of Alpine luxury and natural wonder.

destinations.name: Netherlands
destinations.description: The Netherlands is a country of extraordinary charm — a flat, beautifully ordered landscape of windmills, tulip fields, and more bicycles than people. Amsterdam's 17th-century canal ring, UNESCO-listed and utterly romantic, is lined with elegant gabled townhouses, world-class museums including the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, and a vibrant café culture. Beyond the capital, Keukenhof's tulip gardens and the windmills of Kinderdijk paint a picture of quintessential Dutch life.

destinations.name: Germany
destinations.description: Germany is a country of extraordinary depth and diversity — from the cosmopolitan energy of Berlin, where Cold War history meets a world-class contemporary art scene, to the fairy-tale Bavarian Alps and the legendary Oktoberfest of Munich. Drive the Romantic Road through medieval towns, cruise the Rhine past vineyard-clad hillsides, explore Hamburg's cutting-edge Elbphilharmonie, and savour a pretzel with a perfectly poured German beer. Few countries pack such cultural richness into a single border.

destinations.name: Belgium
destinations.description: Belgium is one of Europe's most underrated treasures — a compact country of extraordinary medieval cities, world-class chocolate and waffle artisans, over 1,500 varieties of locally brewed beer, and some of Europe's finest Art Nouveau architecture. Wander the canal-laced streets of Bruges, explore Brussels' ornate Grand Place (a UNESCO World Heritage Site), and discover the vibrant dining scene of Ghent. Belgium punches far above its weight in culture, gastronomy, and sheer charm.

destinations.name: Luxembourg
destinations.description: Luxembourg is one of Europe's most surprising destinations — a tiny grand duchy of medieval fortresses perched above dramatic river gorges, a cosmopolitan capital that blends old-world charm with modern sophistication, and a countryside of rolling vineyards along the Moselle River. Luxembourg City's old town and fortifications are UNESCO-listed, and the country's blend of French, German, and Luxembourgish cultures creates a uniquely rich cultural tapestry.

destinations.name: Greece
destinations.description: Greece is where Western civilisation was born — a land of ancient mythology, dazzling white-washed island villages, crystal-clear Aegean waters, and the world's most iconic ruins. Stand in awe at the Acropolis in Athens, watch the sun set over Santorini's caldera in a blaze of orange and pink, and dance until dawn in Mykonos' legendary beach clubs. Greece is romance, history, and breathtaking beauty all rolled into one.

destinations.name: Sri Lanka
destinations.description: Sri Lanka is a vibrant island nation that offers a magical blend of misty highlands, ancient spiritual heritage, and golden tropical shores. Travelers can journey from the bustling streets of Colombo to the serene tea plantations of 'Little England' (Nuwara Eliya) and explore UNESCO World Heritage sites like the historic Galle Fort. Whether you are witnessing gentle giants at an elephant sanctuary or catching panoramic views from a mountain tower, the island promises a soul-stirring adventure for every explorer.

destinations.name: Bhutan
destinations.description: Bhutan is a serene Himalayan kingdom known for its dramatic landscapes, ancient fortress-like Dzongs, and a unique philosophy of Gross National Happiness. As the 'Last Great Himalayan Kingdom,' it offers a mindful journey through lush valleys, cliffside monasteries, and vibrant cultural festivals. From the spiritual heights of Tiger's Nest to the rare black-necked cranes of Phobjikha Valley, it is a destination that blends natural beauty with deep-rooted Vajrayana Buddhist traditions.

destinations.name: Kazakhstan
destinations.description: Kazakhstan is Central Asia's emerging powerhouse — a vast country of dramatic contrasts where futuristic architecture in Nur-Sultan meets the ancient Silk Road bazaars of Shymkent, the soaring Tian Shan mountains tower over the cosmopolitan café culture of Almaty, and the surreal Charyn Canyon rivals the American Grand Canyon. Kazakhstan is a frontier destination for the true explorer.

destinations.name: Mongolia
destinations.description: Mongolia is the last great wilderness — a country of boundless steppes, the legendary Gobi Desert, turquoise glacial lakes, and a nomadic culture unchanged for centuries. Ride horses across open grassland under skies more densely star-packed than almost anywhere on Earth, stay in traditional ger camps with herder families, and explore the legacy of Genghis Khan's vast empire. Mongolia is raw, real, and utterly unforgettable.

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.description: Dubai is a city that turned the impossible into reality — the world's tallest building, man-made islands, indoor ski slopes, and a gold souk. This dazzling desert metropolis blends futuristic architecture with rich Emirati heritage, offering desert safaris under starlit skies, dhow cruises on the Creek, and shopping at gold-laden souks. An experience unlike anywhere else on Earth.

destinations.name: Egypt
destinations.description: Egypt is the cradle of civilisation — a land where colossal pyramids rise from golden desert sands, river cruises glide past temple complexes thousands of years old, and bazaars overflow with the scent of spices and the sound of haggling. From the Sphinx to the Valley of the Kings, from the dive reefs of Dahab to the turquoise waters of Hurghada, Egypt is a destination of timeless, jaw-dropping wonder.

destinations.name: Turkey
destinations.description: Turkey is where East meets West in the most spectacular fashion — a land of fairy-tale hot air balloons over the honeycombed valleys of Cappadocia, the magnificent domed skyline of Istanbul's grand mosques, turquoise Aegean coves accessible only by boat, and ancient ruins scattered across wild olive groves. Turkey is one of the world's great crossroads, and one of its most generous, vibrant, and rewarding destinations.

destinations.name: Oman
destinations.description: Oman is the Arabian Peninsula's best-kept secret — a country of spectacular natural diversity where rugged desert dunes meet dramatic fjords, ancient walled fortresses, and some of the most pristine turtle nesting beaches in the world. The historic souks of Muscat, the dramatic Wadi Shab gorges, the starlit sands of Wahiba, and the lush monsoon greenery of Dhofar make Oman a destination unlike any other in the Middle East.

packages.title: Bali, Indonesia
packages.subtitle: Tropical Paradise
packages.short_description: Experience the magic of the Island of Gods
packages.description: Discover the enchanting island of Bali with its lush rice terraces, ancient temples, pristine beaches, and vibrant nightlife. This carefully curated 7-day journey takes you through the spiritual heart of Ubud, the stunning cliffs of Uluwatu, and the party-ready shores of Seminyak. From sunrise treks at Mount Batur to sunset dinners overlooking the Indian Ocean — every moment is designed to captivate.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Seminyak Beach
itinerary.description: Airport pickup and transfer to your luxury beach resort. Evening free to explore Seminyak's vibrant beach clubs. Welcome dinner at a beachfront restaurant with traditional Balinese dance performance.

itinerary.title: Ubud Art & Rice Terraces
itinerary.description: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary. Explore Tegallalang Rice Terraces. Afternoon art gallery walk and traditional craft workshop. Evening spa treatment at a world-class Ubud spa.

itinerary.title: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn departure for Mount Batur sunrise trek (1,717m). Breakfast at the summit watching the sun rise over Lake Batur. Return for afternoon relaxation. Visit a coffee plantation for Luwak coffee tasting.

itinerary.title: Temple Trail
itinerary.description: Visit the iconic Tanah Lot sea temple. Explore Uluwatu Temple on dramatic cliffs. Experience the Kecak Fire Dance at sunset. Fine dining at Jimbaran Bay seafood restaurants.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Day Trip
itinerary.description: Speedboat to Nusa Penida island. Visit Kelingking Beach (T-Rex cliff). Snorkel with Manta Rays at Manta Point. Crystal Bay beach time. Return to Bali by sunset.

itinerary.title: Waterfall & Adventure
itinerary.description: Visit Tegenungan and Tibumana waterfalls. White water rafting on the Ayung River. Afternoon ATV ride through rice fields and jungle trails. Farewell dinner at a cliff-top restaurant.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free for last-minute shopping at Ubud Market. Check-out and airport transfer. Departure with unforgettable memories.

inclusions: Mount Batur sunrise trek with guide
Nusa Penida day trip with snorkeling gear

packages.title: Paris, France
packages.subtitle: City of Love
packages.short_description: Romance, art, and cuisine in the world's most beautiful city
packages.description: Fall in love with Paris — the city of lights, art, and culinary excellence. Stroll along the Seine at sunset, marvel at the Eiffel Tower's nightly sparkle, wander through the halls of the Louvre, and indulge in authentic French patisserie. This 5-day experience blends iconic landmarks with hidden gems known only to locals.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Montmartre
itinerary.description: Transfer to your boutique hotel in Le Marais. Afternoon walking tour of Montmartre — Sacré-Cœur, Place du Tertre, and the artistic charm. Evening Seine river cruise with champagne.

itinerary.title: Eiffel Tower & Art
itinerary.description: Morning visit to the Eiffel Tower with skip-the-line access. Lunch at a classic Parisian brasserie. Afternoon at Musée d'Orsay. Evening free for Champs-Élysées exploration.

itinerary.title: Louvre & Latin Quarter
itinerary.description: Half-day guided tour of the Louvre. Lunch in the Latin Quarter. Visit Notre-Dame (exterior) and Shakespeare & Company bookshop. Evening Seine-side picnic experience.

itinerary.title: Versailles Day Trip
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion to Palace of Versailles. Guided tour of the palace, gardens, and Marie Antoinette's estate. Return for farewell dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free for last-minute shopping at Galeries Lafayette. Patisserie class (optional). Airport transfer and departure.

inclusions: 4 nights in boutique Le Marais hotel

packages.title: Santorini, Greece
packages.subtitle: Aegean Dream
packages.short_description: Blue domes, golden sunsets, and Mediterranean bliss
packages.description: Santorini is where dreams meet reality. Wander through whitewashed villages perched on volcanic cliffs, swim in crystal-clear Aegean waters, and watch sunsets that paint the sky in shades of amber and rose. This intimate 6-day journey unveils the island's ancient history, world-class wines, and breathtaking beauty.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Oia
itinerary.description: Airport transfer to your cliffside cave hotel in Oia. Afternoon free to explore the village's narrow lanes. Iconic Oia sunset viewing from the castle ruins. Welcome dinner at a caldera-view restaurant.

itinerary.title: Fira & Caldera Walk
itinerary.description: Hike the scenic Fira-to-Oia trail along the caldera rim (10km). Visit the Museum of Prehistoric Thera. Afternoon shopping in Fira. Evening wine tasting at Santo Wines.

itinerary.title: Volcano & Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Boat trip to the volcanic island of Nea Kameni. Hike to the active crater. Swim in the natural hot springs of Palea Kameni. Afternoon at Red Beach.

itinerary.title: Wine & Culture
itinerary.description: Visit 3 award-winning wineries along the Wine Road. Traditional Greek cooking class. Afternoon at Perissa Black Sand Beach. Evening free.

itinerary.title: Sailing & Farewell
itinerary.description: Full-day catamaran sailing cruise around the island. Snorkeling stops at hidden coves. BBQ lunch on board. Sunset sailing with champagne. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free. Last photos at the Blue Dome Church. Airport transfer.

inclusions: 5 nights in Oia cave hotel with caldera view

packages.title: Tokyo, Japan
packages.subtitle: Neon Nights
packages.short_description: Where ancient tradition meets futuristic innovation
packages.description: Tokyo is a city of contrasts — where centuries-old shrines stand in the shadow of neon-lit skyscrapers. Experience the electric energy of Shibuya, the serenity of Meiji Shrine, the culinary mastery of Tsukiji, and the pop-culture explosion of Akihabara. This 8-day adventure covers Tokyo and day trips to Mount Fuji and Kamakura.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Arrival at Narita/Haneda. Transfer to Shinjuku hotel. Evening orientation walk through Golden Gai and Omoide Yokocho.

itinerary.title: Classic Tokyo
itinerary.description: Meiji Shrine morning visit. Harajuku's Takeshita Street. Lunch in Shibuya. Shibuya Crossing experience. Afternoon at teamLab Borderless digital art museum.

itinerary.title: Asakusa & Akihabara
itinerary.description: Senso-ji Temple and Nakamise-dori. Sumida River cruise. Afternoon in Akihabara — anime, manga, and gaming culture. Evening ramen tour.

itinerary.title: Mount Fuji Day Trip
itinerary.description: Bullet train to Kawaguchiko. 5th Station visit (weather permitting). Lunch with Fuji view. Visit Oshino Hakkai springs. Return to Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tsukiji & Ginza
itinerary.description: Tsukiji Outer Market food tour. Sushi-making class. Afternoon shopping in Ginza. Evening Tokyo Tower visit.

itinerary.title: Kamakura Day Trip
itinerary.description: Visit Great Buddha of Kamakura. Hase-dera Temple. Bamboo grove walk. Lunch at a local izakaya. Return for evening in Roppongi.

itinerary.title: Pop Culture & Farewell
itinerary.description: Pokémon Center & Nintendo Store. Animate in Ikebukuro. Robot Restaurant show. Farewell kaiseki dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free. Convenience store breakfast run (a true Tokyo experience!). Airport transfer.

packages.title: Swiss Alps
packages.subtitle: Mountain Majesty
packages.short_description: Peaks, lakes, and alpine luxury at its finest
packages.description: The Swiss Alps offer an experience unlike any other — snow-capped peaks, pristine lakes, charming villages, and world-class hospitality. Ride cogwheel trains to Europe's highest railway station, paraglide over Interlaken, cruise on Lake Lucerne, and indulge in Swiss chocolate and fondue.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lucerne
itinerary.description: Transfer from Zurich airport to Lucerne. Afternoon walking tour — Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument. Evening lakeside dinner.

itinerary.title: Mount Pilatus
itinerary.description: Golden Round Trip to Mount Pilatus — boat, cogwheel train, and gondola. Summit views of 73 alpine peaks. Return for evening free in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Interlaken & Paragliding
itinerary.description: Scenic train to Interlaken. Optional tandem paragliding over Lake Thun. Afternoon stroll through Interlaken. Evening at a traditional Swiss chalet restaurant.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
itinerary.description: Cogwheel train to Jungfraujoch (3,454m) — the highest railway station in Europe. Ice Palace, Sphinx Observatory, panoramic views. Return via Grindelwald.

itinerary.title: Zermatt & Matterhorn
itinerary.description: Train to Zermatt. Gornergrat Bahn to view the Matterhorn up close. Village exploration. Swiss chocolate workshop. Farewell fondue dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free. Transfer to Zurich Airport. Departure.

packages.title: Japan Cherry Blossom
packages.subtitle: Sakura Season Special
packages.short_description: Witness Japan's most magical season in full bloom
packages.description: Experience Japan during its most enchanting season — cherry blossom season. Watch thousands of sakura trees burst into delicate pink clouds across Kyoto's ancient temples, Tokyo's modern parks, and Osaka's riverside walkways. This 7-day journey perfectly balances traditional Japanese culture, stunning natural beauty, and modern urban energy.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Welcome at Narita Airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening walk through Shinjuku Gyoen for cherry blossoms under lights (yozakura).

itinerary.title: Tokyo Sakura Spots
itinerary.description: Ueno Park hanami experience. Chidorigafuchi moat boat ride under cherry blossoms. Afternoon at Meguro River cherry blossom lane. Evening in Shibuya.

itinerary.title: Bullet Train to Kyoto
itinerary.description: Shinkansen to Kyoto. Visit Fushimi Inari Shrine (10,000 torii gates). Afternoon at Philosopher's Path lined with cherry trees. Evening geisha district walk in Gion.

itinerary.title: Kyoto Temples & Gardens
itinerary.description: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion). Arashiyama Bamboo Grove. Tenryu-ji Temple gardens. Traditional tea ceremony experience. Evening kaiseki dinner.

itinerary.title: Nara Day Trip
itinerary.description: Visit Nara Park and feed the sacred deer among cherry blossoms. Todai-ji Temple with the Great Buddha. Return to Kyoto for evening free time.

itinerary.title: Osaka Exploration
itinerary.description: Train to Osaka. Osaka Castle surrounded by 600+ cherry trees. Street food tour in Dotonbori. Afternoon at Osaka Mint Bureau cherry blossom tunnel. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free. Transfer to Kansai International Airport. Departure with sakura memories.

inclusions: 6 nights in premium hotels (Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka)

packages.title: Dubai Luxury Escape
packages.subtitle: Glitz & Glamour
packages.short_description: The ultimate luxury experience in the desert metropolis
packages.description: Dubai is where impossibility becomes reality. From the world's tallest building to man-made islands and indoor ski slopes, this city defies expectations at every turn. Experience luxury beyond imagination — desert safaris under starlit skies, dhow cruises on the Creek, and shopping in gold-laden souks.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Marina Walk
itinerary.description: Airport pickup in luxury vehicle. Check into 5-star hotel. Evening Marina walk and dinner at a rooftop restaurant overlooking Palm Jumeirah.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa & Old Dubai
itinerary.description: At The Top — Burj Khalifa (148th floor). Dubai Mall and Dubai Aquarium. Afternoon at Dubai Creek — abra ride, Gold Souk, Spice Souk. Evening dhow cruise dinner.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Morning free at hotel pool/beach. Afternoon desert safari — dune bashing, camel riding, sandboarding. BBQ dinner under the stars with belly dancing and falconry show.

itinerary.title: Palm & Atlantis
itinerary.description: Visit Atlantis The Palm — Aquaventure Waterpark. Lunch at Nobu. Afternoon at JBR Beach. Evening at Dubai Fountain show & farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free for Mall of Emirates or Miracle Garden visit. Airport transfer.

inclusions: Burj Khalifa At The Top tickets

packages.title: Kerala Backwaters
packages.subtitle: God's Own Country
packages.short_description: Tranquility, spices, and emerald waterways
packages.description: Kerala, aptly called God's Own Country, offers an experience that soothes the soul. Cruise through serene backwaters on traditional houseboats, trek through spice plantations in Munnar, spot wildlife in Periyar, and relax with authentic Ayurvedic treatments. This 4-day journey is pure rejuvenation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi
itinerary.description: Airport pickup. Visit Fort Kochi — Chinese fishing nets, St. Francis Church, Jewish Town. Evening Kathakali dance performance. Dinner at a seafood restaurant.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Gardens
itinerary.description: Drive to Munnar through winding mountain roads. Visit a tea factory and tea museum. Explore Eravikulam National Park. Evening at a spice plantation with cooking demo.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey. Board a premium houseboat for overnight stay. Cruise through palm-fringed canals and paddy fields. Fresh Kerala lunch and dinner on board. Sunset over the backwaters.

itinerary.title: Ayurveda & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning Ayurvedic massage session. Disembark houseboat. Transfer to Kochi airport. Departure refreshed and renewed.

packages.title: Santorini Sunsets
packages.subtitle: Golden Hour Experience
packages.short_description: Chase the most spectacular sunsets on earth
packages.description: This premium Santorini experience is built around the island's legendary sunsets. Stay in a private cave suite overlooking the caldera, sail on a luxury catamaran, explore volcanic hot springs, and discover centuries of Aegean history. Every evening ends with a sunset that redefines beauty.

itinerary.title: Arrival & First Sunset
itinerary.description: Airport transfer to Oia cave suite. Check-in and champagne welcome. First sunset from your private terrace. Welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Caldera Hiking
itinerary.description: Scenic Fira-to-Oia hike along the caldera rim. Wine tasting at sunset viewpoint winery. Traditional Greek dinner.

itinerary.title: Volcano Adventure
itinerary.description: Boat to volcanic island. Crater hike. Hot springs swim. Red Beach afternoon. Sunset at Akrotiri Lighthouse.

itinerary.title: Wine & Cooking
itinerary.description: Visit 3 boutique wineries. Traditional Greek cooking class. Black Sand Beach afternoon. Evening free.

itinerary.title: Catamaran Sailing
itinerary.description: Full-day luxury catamaran cruise. Hidden coves snorkeling. BBQ lunch onboard. Sunset sailing with champagne. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free. Airport transfer. Departure.

inclusions: 5 nights in Oia cave suite (caldera view)

packages.title: Bali Adventure
packages.subtitle: Thrill & Tranquility
packages.short_description: Adventure sports meets tropical relaxation
packages.description: This Bali adventure trip is designed for thrill-seekers who also love to unwind. Combine adrenaline-pumping activities like white water rafting, ATV rides, and cliff jumping with serene temple visits, rice terrace walks, and beachside relaxation. The perfect balance of adventure and chill.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Beach
itinerary.description: Airport pickup. Transfer to Seminyak resort. Evening beach sunset. Welcome seafood dinner.

itinerary.title: Ubud Adventure
itinerary.description: White water rafting on Ayung River. Monkey Forest visit. Rice terraces trek. Evening cultural dinner.

itinerary.title: Volcano & ATV
itinerary.description: Mount Batur sunrise trek. Coffee plantation visit. Afternoon ATV quad biking through jungle and rice paddies.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping
itinerary.description: Speedboat to Nusa Penida. Kelingking Beach. Snorkeling with manta rays. Crystal Bay cliff jumping. Return to Bali.

itinerary.title: Temples & Farewell
itinerary.description: Tanah Lot Temple. Uluwatu Temple. Kecak Fire Dance at sunset. Farewell dinner at Jimbaran Bay.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free. Ubud Market shopping. Airport transfer.

packages.title: Paris Romance
packages.subtitle: Amour à Paris
packages.short_description: The ultimate romantic escape in the city of love
packages.description: Paris Romance is curated for couples seeking the ultimate romantic getaway. Private Seine cruises, candlelit dinners at the Eiffel Tower, strolls through Montmartre at golden hour, and a day trip to the magnificent Versailles. This isn't just a trip — it's a love letter to travel.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Montmartre
itinerary.description: Arrival in Paris. Transfer to Le Marais boutique hotel. Montmartre sunset walk. Sacré-Cœur views. Intimate bistro dinner.

itinerary.title: Eiffel Tower & Seine
itinerary.description: Skip-the-line Eiffel Tower visit. Lunch at Tour Eiffel restaurant. Afternoon at Tuileries Garden. Private sunset Seine cruise with champagne.

itinerary.title: Art & Culture
itinerary.description: Morning at the Louvre (guided). Latin Quarter stroll. Shakespeare & Company. Afternoon at Musée d'Orsay. Evening at a hidden speakeasy.

itinerary.title: Versailles
itinerary.description: Full-day Versailles excursion. Palace, gardens, and Marie Antoinette's hamlet. Return for Michelin-starred farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning patisserie-hopping. Galeries Lafayette. Airport transfer.

inclusions: 4 nights in Le Marais boutique hotel

packages.title: Ladakh Ultimate Circuit
packages.subtitle: High Altitude Adventure
packages.short_description: Route: Leh – Nubra – Pangong – Hanle – Umling La
packages.description: The ultimate Ladakh experience for adventure seekers. This circuit covers the most remote and breathtaking parts of Ladakh, including the world's highest motorable pass, Umling La. Experience the stark beauty of the cold desert, the turquoise waters of Pangong Tso, and the spiritual calm of ancient monasteries.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Leh airport pickup. Rest for complete day for acclimatization. Evening visit Shanti Stupa.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Sangam (Indus-Zanskar), Magnetic Hill, Hall of Fame, and Patthar Sahib Gurudwara.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley
itinerary.description: Drive via Khardung La (5,359m). Visit Diskit Monastery. Double-hump camel ride at Hunder sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Turtuk & Back
itinerary.description: Visit Turtuk, the last village on the Indo-Pak border. Explore Baltic culture and orchards.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso
itinerary.description: Drive via Shyok River. Overnight stay in camps near the world-famous Pangong Lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Hanle
itinerary.description: Off-roading along the border to the remote village of Hanle, home to the Indian Astronomical Observatory.

itinerary.title: Umling La Loop
itinerary.description: The peak of the journey — summiting Umling La (19,024 ft), the highest motorable road in the world.

itinerary.title: Hanle to Leh via Tso Moriri
itinerary.description: Visit the high-altitude lake Tso Moriri before returning to Leh. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Leh airport for your flight back home.

inclusions: Inner Line Permits and Wildlife fees

packages.title: Kedarnath Spiritual Trek
packages.subtitle: Divine Himalayan Journey
packages.short_description: A soul-stirring trek to the holiest of shrines
packages.description: Join thousands of devotees on a journey of faith to Kedarnath Dham. This 6-day tour covers Haridwar, Rishikesh, and the 16km trek from Sonprayag to the magnificent temple of Lord Shiva, nestled against the snowy peaks of the Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Haridwar Arrival
itinerary.description: Pickup from Haridwar. Attend Ganga Aarti. Evening orientation.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Drive along the Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers. Visit Devprayag Sangam.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath Trek
itinerary.description: Drive to Sonprayag. Start the 16km trek. Overnight stay near temple.

itinerary.title: Temple Darshan & Descent
itinerary.description: Early morning Darshan and Aarti. Trek down to Sonprayag and drive back to Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi to Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Drive to Rishikesh. Evening free to explore Laxman Jhula and markets.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Ganga rafting (optional). Transfer to Haridwar station/Dehradun airport.

packages.title: Varanasi Heritage Walk
packages.subtitle: The Eternal City
packages.short_description: Experience the world's oldest living city
packages.description: Varanasi is not just a city; it's an emotion. Explore the ancient ghats, witness the grand Ganga Aarti, taste the world-famous street food, and walk through the labyrinthine alleys where history breathes in every corner.

itinerary.title: Evening Ganga Aarti
itinerary.description: Arrival and transfer. Evening boat ride to witness the spectacular Dashashwamedh Ghat Aarti.

itinerary.title: Old City & Sarnath
itinerary.description: Sunrise boat ride. Kashi Vishwanath Temple visit. Afternoon trip to Sarnath (where Buddha preached).

itinerary.title: Galleries & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Banaras Hindu University. Street food breakfast. Local silk weaving units. Transfer for departure.

packages.title: Spiti Valley Expedition
packages.subtitle: Middle Land Adventure
packages.short_description: A journey through the high-altitude cold desert
packages.description: Spiti Valley is a gateway to paradise for those who seek adventure in the lap of the Himalayas. Known as the "Middle Land" between India and Tibet, it offers centuries-old monasteries, world's highest post office, and landscapes that look like they belong on another planet.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Kalpa
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through Kinnaur valley. Overnight at Kalpa with Kinner Kailash views.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Kaza
itinerary.description: Crossing the Khab Sangam. Visit Nako Lake. Enter Spiti Valley.

itinerary.title: Key Monastery & Kibber
itinerary.description: Visit the 1000-year-old Key Monastery. Explore Kibber, one of the world's highest villages.

itinerary.title: Hikkim, Langza & Komic
itinerary.description: Visit the world's highest post office in Hikkim. See Buddha statue at Langza.

itinerary.title: Pin Valley & Mudh
itinerary.description: Explore the wildlife-rich Pin Valley National Park and the beautiful village of Mudh.

itinerary.title: Dhankar Monastery & Tabo
itinerary.description: Visit the cliff-hanging Dhankar Monastery and the Ajanta of the Himalayas — Tabo Monastery.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal
itinerary.description: Drive over Kunzum Pass. Trek to the Moon Lake — Chandratal (Camping).

itinerary.title: Return to Manali
itinerary.description: Crossing the Rohtang Pass (or tunnel) and concluding the journey in Manali.

packages.title: Kashmir Paradise Tour
packages.subtitle: Heaven on Earth
packages.short_description: Experience the magic of shikaras and snow
packages.description: From the floating gardens of Dal Lake to the snow-covered peaks of Gulmarg, Kashmir is a dream come true. This 6-day tour is designed to show you the best of the valley — Srinagar, Pahalgam, and Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Arrival
itinerary.description: Houseboat check-in. Evening shikara ride on Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam - Valley of Shepherds
itinerary.description: Visit Betaab Valley and Aru Valley. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg - Meadow of Flowers
itinerary.description: Gondola ride (Level 1 & 2). Snow activities. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg - Meadow of Gold
itinerary.description: Day trip to Thajiwas Glacier. Pony rides. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Mughal Gardens (Shalimar, Nishat). Shankaracharya Temple visit.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Local market shopping for saffron and walnuts. Airport transfer.

packages.title: Manali Weekend Escape
packages.subtitle: Himalayan Retreat
packages.short_description: Best for a quick mountain getaway
packages.description: Manali is every traveler's first love. Experience the cold mountain air, the gushing Beas river, and the colorful Tibetan markets. Perfect for a quick recharge.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Old Manali
itinerary.description: Evening at leisure. Explore Old Manali's cafes and Hadimba Temple.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Rohtang Tunnel
itinerary.description: Adrenaline day! Paragliding in Solang. Drive through Atal Tunnel.

itinerary.title: Vashisht & Jogini Falls
itinerary.description: Morning hike to Jogini Falls. Visit Vashisht hot springs. Evening shopping at Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Naggar Castle & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit the historic Naggar Castle. Evening Volvo to home.

packages.title: Rishikesh Adventure Quest
packages.subtitle: Rafting & Yoga
packages.short_description: Find your peace and thrill in the holy city
packages.description: The Yoga Capital of the World offers more than just spirituality. Dive into the world-famous Ganga river rafting experience and camp under the stars.

itinerary.title: Riverside Camping
itinerary.description: Arrival. Evening bonfire and music at the riverside camp.

itinerary.title: Ganga White Water Rafting
itinerary.description: Level 16km rafting from Shivpuri. Cliff jumping and body surfing.

itinerary.title: Beatles Ashram & Aarti
itinerary.description: Morning yoga. Visit Beatles Ashram. Attend Triveni Ghat Aarti before departure.

packages.title: Jaisalmer Desert Safari
packages.subtitle: Golden City Experience
packages.short_description: Stay in the heart of Thar Desert
packages.description: Spend a night under the milky way, ride camels over golden sand dunes, and explore the living fort of Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Fort Walk
itinerary.description: Explore the Golden Fort and Patwon-ki-Haveli. Evening at Gadisar Lake.

itinerary.title: Sam Sand Dunes Night
itinerary.description: Jeep safari and camel safari. Cultural folk dance and dinner. Night stay in luxury tents.

itinerary.title: Kuldhara & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit the haunted village of Kuldhara. Transfer for departure.

packages.title: Kasol & Kheerganga Trek
packages.subtitle: Parvati Valley Magic
packages.short_description: The ultimate hippie trail and hot springs trek
packages.description: Experience the mystical Parvati Valley. This trip covers Kasol (the Mini Israel of India), Manikaran, and the famous 12km trek to Kheerganga where you can soak in natural hot springs under the stars.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kasol
itinerary.description: Explore old Kasol markets and cafes by the Parvati River.

itinerary.title: Manikaran & Chalal
itinerary.description: Visit the Manikaran Gurudwara and a serene riverside walk to Chalal village.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga Trek
itinerary.description: Start the lush green trek. Reach the summit for a dip in the holy hot spring.

itinerary.title: Trek Down & Departure
itinerary.description: Trek back to Barshaini and board the evening Volvo.

packages.title: Munnar Tea Garden Retreat
packages.subtitle: Highlands & Spices
packages.short_description: Wander through emerald tea estates and spice forests
packages.description: Discover the winding roads and mist-covered hills of Munnar. Perfect for nature lovers and tea enthusiasts.

itinerary.title: Munnar Arrival
itinerary.description: Check into a boutique plantation resort. Evening walk in spice gardens.

itinerary.title: Tea Museum & Eravikulam
itinerary.description: Learn the art of tea making and spot the Nilgiri Tahr in Eravikulam National Park.

itinerary.title: Mattupetty & Echo Point
itinerary.description: Visit the scenic dam and the famous Echo Point under the sun.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Kochi airport/station.

packages.title: Pushkar Cultural Soul
packages.subtitle: Holy Lake & Temples
packages.description: A spiritual and artistic journey to the world's only Brahma temple and the holy Pushkar lake.

itinerary.title: Pushkar Lake & Arti
itinerary.description: Arrival. Witness the evening Aarti at Pushkar Ghat.

itinerary.title: Temple Trail & Savitri Mata
itinerary.description: Visit the Brahma Temple and take the ropeway to Savitri Mata temple for panoramic views.

packages.title: Udaipur: City of Lakes
packages.subtitle: Royal Rajasthan
packages.description: Live like royalty in the Venice of the East. Explore majestic palaces and enjoy romantic sunset boat rides on Lake Pichola.

itinerary.title: City Palace & Crystal Gallery
itinerary.description: Explore the grand architecture of the Mewar Dynasty.

itinerary.title: Lake Pichola & Jagmandir
itinerary.description: Exclusive boat ride and lunch at Jagmandir island palace.

packages.title: Thailand Explorer
packages.subtitle: Land of Smiles
packages.short_description: Temples, beaches, street food and Thai hospitality
packages.description: Thailand is a country that awakens all your senses — from the golden spires of Bangkok's ancient temples and the chaos of its floating markets to the turquoise waters of Phuket's bays and the night-market buzz of Chiang Mai. This 7-day journey is the perfect introduction to "The Land of Smiles."

itinerary.title: Bangkok Arrival
itinerary.description: Transfer to your hotel in the heart of Bangkok. Evening cruise on the Chao Phraya river with a sunset dinner on board.

itinerary.title: Grand Palace & Temples
itinerary.description: Full-day guided tour of the Grand Palace, Wat Phra Kaew (Emerald Buddha), and Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha). Afternoon tuk-tuk ride through the old city lanes.

itinerary.title: Floating Markets & Street Food
itinerary.description: Early morning visit to Damnoen Saduak Floating Market. Afternoon Street Food Tour in Chinatown. Evening at Asiatique Riverfront night market.

itinerary.title: Fly to Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Chiang Mai. Afternoon visit to Doi Suthep temple on the mountain. Evening cooking class with a local chef.

itinerary.title: Elephant Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Full-day ethical elephant sanctuary experience — feeding, bathing, and walking with rescued elephants in a natural habitat. Return for evening at the Night Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Phuket Transfer & Beach
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Phuket. Afternoon at Patong Beach. Sunset dinner at a cliff-top restaurant overlooking Phang Nga Bay. Evening at Bangla Road.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning speedboat to the stunning Phi Phi Islands — Monkey Beach, Maya Bay (The Beach!), snorkeling at colorful reefs. Return to Phuket for evening departure.

inclusions: 6 nights in 4-star hotels (Bangkok 2N, Chiang Mai 2N, Phuket 2N)
exclusions: Thailand visa (on arrival available for Indians)

packages.title: Thailand Beach Bliss
packages.subtitle: Island Hopping Paradise
packages.short_description: Crystal waters, white sands, and island sunsets
packages.description: Skip the city rush and dive straight into Thailand's legendary island paradise. From Krabi's dramatic limestone karsts to the emerald lagoons of Koh Lanta and the secluded coves of the Similan Islands — this beach-focused trip is a tropical dream made real.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Krabi
itinerary.description: Transfer to your beachfront resort in Ao Nang. Evening sunset walk on the beach and dinner at a seaside shack.

itinerary.title: 4 Islands Tour
itinerary.description: Full-day longtail boat tour — Tub Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and Tup Island. Snorkeling over coral gardens and a beachside BBQ lunch.

itinerary.title: Railay Beach & Rock Climbing
itinerary.description: Longtail to Railay Beach (accessible only by sea). Optional rock climbing on limestone cliffs. Afternoon free at Phra Nang Cave Beach. Sunset cocktails.

itinerary.title: Koh Lanta Day Trip
itinerary.description: Speedboat to Koh Lanta for a full beach day. Amazing snorkeling at Hin Daeng coral reef. Sunset views from the old town lighthouse.

itinerary.title: Morning Kayak & Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise sea kayaking through mangrove tunnels and sea caves. Transfer to Krabi airport for departure.

inclusions: 4 nights beachfront resort in Ao Nang
4 Islands longtail boat tour with BBQ lunch

packages.title: Vietnam Classic Tour
packages.subtitle: North to South
packages.short_description: From Hanoi's old quarter to Hoi An's lantern-lit streets
packages.description: Vietnam is a long, slender country of astonishing variety — ancient imperial cities, emerald rice terraces, world-famous street food and stunning coastline. This 8-day north-to-south journey takes you from the charming chaos of Hanoi through the UNESCO wonder of Ha Long Bay to the tailors and temples of Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Hanoi Arrival
itinerary.description: Transfer to your hotel in the Old Quarter. Evening cyclo tour through 36 ancient streets. Street food walk — pho, banh mi, and egg coffee.

itinerary.title: Hanoi Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum complex, Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the Temple of Literature. Afternoon water puppet show. Evening free in the Old Quarter.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Cruise (Day 1)
itinerary.description: Morning transfer to Ha Long Bay. Board your 2-day cruise. Kayaking through limestone karsts. Visit Sung Sot Cave (Surprise Cave). Sunset on the sundeck with cocktails.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Cruise (Day 2)
itinerary.description: Sunrise Tai Chi on deck. Cooking class on board (Vietnamese spring rolls). Visit floating fishing village. Return to Hanoi. Evening flight to Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Hoi An Ancient Town
itinerary.description: Morning at Hoi An's UNESCO Heritage Old Town — Japanese Covered Bridge, Assembly Halls, and tailors. Afternoon bicycle ride to An Bang Beach. Evening lantern festival on Thu Bon River.

itinerary.title: My Son Temples & Cooking Class
itinerary.description: Morning boat to My Son Hindu temple complex (UNESCO). Afternoon Vietnamese cooking class at a riverside farm. Free evening in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Fly to Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Saigon. Afternoon city tour — Ben Thanh Market, Reunification Palace, War Remnants Museum. Evening Bui Vien Walking Street.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning Cu Chi Tunnels tour — crawl through the historic underground network. Return to city. Airport transfer for departure.

inclusions: 7 nights accommodation (Hanoi 2N, Ha Long Cruise 1N, Hoi An 2N, Ho Chi Minh 2N)

packages.title: Ha Long Bay Luxury Cruise
packages.subtitle: Wonder of the World
packages.short_description: Sail through 1,900 limestone islands and emerald waters
packages.description: Ha Long Bay is one of the most spectacular natural wonders on earth — 1,969 limestone karsts rising from emerald-green water over 1,500 square kilometers. This exclusive 4-day cruise experience combines luxury on the water with kayaking sea caves, hiking pristine islands, and cooking Vietnamese cuisine on board.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay
itinerary.description: Transfer from Hanoi. Board luxury cruise. Welcome lunch. Afternoon kayaking through hidden lagoons. Sunset squid fishing. Dinner on deck.

itinerary.title: Island Trek & Caves
itinerary.description: Sunrise yoga on deck. Visit Sung Sot Cave and Ti Top Island for panoramic views. Afternoon at a private beach. Cooking class: Vietnamese spring rolls.

itinerary.title: Bai Tu Long Bay
itinerary.description: Sail deeper into the less-visited Bai Tu Long Bay. Visit Cong Dam floating village. Afternoon kayaking through bat caves and mangroves. BBQ dinner on deck.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning Tai Chi. Brunch on board. Disembark and transfer to Hanoi.

packages.title: Singapore Highlights
packages.subtitle: The Lion City
packages.short_description: Futuristic skylines, garden domes, and chilli crab
packages.description: Singapore is the world's most impeccably planned city — blending a tropical garden city with Michelin-starred street food, spectacular universal studios, and jaw-dropping architecture. This 5-day package covers every iconic experience without missing a beat.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Marina Bay
itinerary.description: Airport transfer by luxury coach. Check-in at Marina Bay Sands area hotel. Evening at the iconic Marina Bay Sands Skypark Observation Deck. Witness the nightly Garden Rhapsody light show at Gardens by the Bay.

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay & Supertrees
itinerary.description: Morning in Flower Dome and Cloud Forest (air-conditioned conservatories). Afternoon at Clarke Quay for river cruise. Evening — Supertree light show and dinner at Satay by the Bay.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island
itinerary.description: Full day at Sentosa Island — Universal Studios Singapore (best rides!), S.E.A. Aquarium, and Siloso Beach. Evening cable car back with city views.

itinerary.title: Cultural Trail
itinerary.description: Morning at Chinatown — Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Maxwell Food Centre for local hawker food. Afternoon at Kampong Glam (Arab Quarter) and Little India. Evening on Orchard Road for world-class shopping.

itinerary.title: Jewel Changi & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Jewel Changi Airport — HSBC Rain Vortex (world's tallest indoor waterfall), Canopy Park. Last Singapore breakfast. Departure.

inclusions: 4 nights in 4-star Marina Bay area hotel
Gardens by the Bay (Flower Dome + Cloud Forest)
Marina Bay Sands Skypark observation deck
exclusions: Singapore visa (visa-free for Indian passports on arrival)

packages.title: Singapore Family Fun
packages.subtitle: Kid-Friendly Adventure
packages.short_description: Adventure for every age — from 5 to 85!
packages.description: Singapore is arguably the world's best family destination. Safe, spotlessly clean, and endlessly exciting — Universal Studios, the world's best aquarium, the amazing Jewel Changi, and an entire island (Sentosa) made for fun. This 4-day family package is optimized for maximum joy with minimal stress.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Night Safari
itinerary.description: Airport transfer. Check-in and rest. Evening at the legendary Singapore Night Safari — the world's first nocturnal wildlife park. Tram ride and walking trails with 900+ animals.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Full day at Universal Studios Singapore — Jurassic World, Transformers ride, Minion Park, and more. Evening at the Resorts World Sentosa waterfront.

itinerary.title: S.E.A. Aquarium & Gardens
itinerary.description: Morning at the S.E.A. Aquarium (world's largest aquarium). Afternoon at Gardens by the Bay — Cloud Forest and Flower dome. Evening Supertree light show.

itinerary.title: Jewel Changi & Departure
itinerary.description: Jewel Changi exploration — HSBC Rain Vortex, Canopy Park slides and nets. Lunch. Airport departure.

inclusions: 3 nights in family-friendly hotel near Sentosa

packages.title: Maldives Overwater Bliss
packages.subtitle: Ultimate Luxury Escape
packages.short_description: Your private overwater villa above a turquoise lagoon
packages.description: The Maldives is not just a destination — it is an emotion. Picture waking up in an overwater villa with the Indian Ocean shimmering beneath a glass floor panel, stepping down your private ladder directly into the sea. This 5-day escape is pure indulgence — world-class snorkeling, dolphin cruises, private sandbank dinners, and sunsets that defy description.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Seaplane Transfer
itinerary.description: Arrive at Malé International Airport. Board a seaplane for a stunning 30-min scenic flight over coral atolls to your private island resort. Check-in to your overwater bungalow. Champagne welcome. Sunset from your private deck.

itinerary.title: House Reef Snorkeling & Spa
itinerary.description: Morning private house reef snorkeling — turtles, rays, and reef sharks guaranteed. Afternoon at the luxury overwater spa. Sunset catamaran cruise with cocktails.

itinerary.title: Dolphin Cruise & Night Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Early evening dolphin watching cruise. Private sandbank picnic dinner under the stars. Night snorkeling in bio-luminescent waters (seasonal).

itinerary.title: Scuba Diving & Sandbar Breakfast
itinerary.description: Morning beginner scuba session at the house reef. Afternoon private sandbar transport for a photoshoot and afternoon tea. Farewell dinner at the over-water restaurant.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure — last swim from your villa deck. Seaplane transfer to Malé. Departure.

inclusions: 4 nights overwater bungalow with glass floor panel

packages.title: Maldives Budget Escape
packages.subtitle: Maafushi Island
packages.short_description: All the beauty of the Maldives, without the luxury price tag
packages.description: You don't need to spend a fortune to experience the Maldives. Maafushi Island is the best-kept secret for budget travelers — a local island with incredible bikini beaches, vibrant snorkeling, and dive centers, all at a fraction of resort prices. This is the Maldives as a real experience, not just a backdrop for Instagram.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Speedboat Transfer
itinerary.description: Arrive at Malé. 30-min speedboat to Maafushi. Check into your guesthouse. Evening at the public beach at sunset.

itinerary.title: Snorkeling & Sandbank
itinerary.description: Morning snorkeling tour to a vibrant coral garden. Afternoon excursion to a private uninhabited sandbank for sunbathing and photos. Sunset on the roof deck of your guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Whale Shark Safari
itinerary.description: Full-day boat trip to South Ari Atoll for whale shark swimming (seasonal, June–November). Stop at a beautiful local housereef for more snorkeling. Back for a local Maldivian dinner.

itinerary.title: Kayaking & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning kayaking around the island. Visit local fish market. Speedboat back to Malé. Departure.

packages.title: Italy: Rome, Florence & Venice
packages.subtitle: The Grand Italian Journey
packages.short_description: Colosseum, Uffizi Gallery, gondolas & the best pizza on Earth
packages.description: Italy is where civilisation, art, and cuisine reached their peak — and this 8-day journey visits its three greatest cities. Rome, the Eternal City, where 2,500 years of history overlap in every street; Florence, the cradle of the Renaissance where Michelangelo's David stands in marble perfection and the Uffizi Gallery holds the world's greatest collection of Renaissance art; and Venice, the floating city of gondolas, golden mosaics, and carnival masks rising improbably from a lagoon. Buon viaggio.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Rome
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel near the historic centre. Evening passeggiata through Trastevere — cobbled lanes, ivy-clad buildings and the world's best street food. Welcome dinner of cacio e pepe and tiramisu.

itinerary.title: Ancient Rome
itinerary.description: Skip-the-line Colosseum, the Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. Afternoon at the Capitoline Museums — the world's oldest national museums. Trevi Fountain at sunset. Gelato on the Spanish Steps.

itinerary.title: Vatican City
itinerary.description: Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel (Michelangelo's ceiling — the greatest work of art ever made). St Peter's Basilica and Piazza. Optional: climb the dome for panoramic Rome views. Evening at Campo de' Fiori market.

itinerary.title: Travel to Florence
itinerary.description: High-speed Frecciarossa train to Florence (1h 30min). Check-in near the Duomo. Afternoon walking tour of the historic centre — Piazza della Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, Ponte Vecchio. Florentine bistecca dinner.

itinerary.title: Florence: Renaissance Masterpieces
itinerary.description: Uffizi Gallery — Botticelli's Birth of Venus, Leonardo, Raphael, Caravaggio. Galleria dell'Accademia — Michelangelo's David (the most famous sculpture in the world). Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore and Brunelleschi's Dome. Evening Oltrarno neighbourhood for artisan workshops and wine bars.

itinerary.title: Tuscany Day Trip
itinerary.description: Half-day Tuscan countryside drive through cypress-lined roads and vineyard estates. Wine and olive oil tasting at a Chianti winery. Medieval hill towns of San Gimignano and Siena. Return to Florence.

itinerary.title: Travel to Venice
itinerary.description: Train to Venice Santa Lucia. Water taxi to hotel. Afternoon: St Mark's Square and Basilica. Doge's Palace. Gondola ride through the Grand Canal at sunset. Venetian seafood dinner.

itinerary.title: Venice & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at the Rialto Market — the world's most photogenic fish and vegetable market. Murano glass-blowing demonstration. Afternoon departure from Venice Marco Polo Airport.

inclusions: 7 nights in 4-star city-centre hotels (Rome 3N, Florence 3N, Venice 1N)

packages.title: Europe Grand Tour
packages.subtitle: Best of the Continent
packages.short_description: Paris, Swiss Alps, Rome & Amsterdam in one epic journey
packages.description: Europe's finest cities and landscapes in one unforgettable 10-day tour. Watch the Eiffel Tower sparkle at night, ride cogwheel trains to the Jungfraujoch glacier, toss a coin in the Trevi Fountain, and drift along Amsterdam's famous canals. This tour is Europe as it should be experienced — at depth, not just on postcards.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paris
itinerary.description: Welcome dinner and evening Seine river cruise.

itinerary.title: Paris Icons
itinerary.description: Eiffel Tower, Louvre, and Champs-Élysées.

itinerary.title: Versailles & TGV to Geneva
itinerary.description: Palace of Versailles in the morning, high-speed train to Geneva in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Lucerne & Mount Pilatus
itinerary.description: Golden round trip to Mount Pilatus — boat, cogwheel train, gondola.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: Cogwheel train to the Top of Europe (3,454m). Ice palace & panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Train to Rome
itinerary.description: Night train from Switzerland to the Eternal City.

itinerary.title: Rome Classics
itinerary.description: Colosseum, Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, and Trevi Fountain.

itinerary.title: Rome to Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Flight to Amsterdam. Evening canal cruise with dinner.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam Highlights
itinerary.description: Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank House, Vondelpark, and cheese market.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Free morning. Schiphol airport departure.

exclusions: International flights to Paris / from Amsterdam

packages.title: Keralan Heights & Hidden Falls
packages.subtitle: Offbeat Kerala Adventure
packages.short_description: Misty meadows, hidden waterfalls & sunset mangroves
packages.description: Escape the tourist trail and discover the wilder, more breathtaking side of Kerala. This 6-day offbeat adventure takes you through the misty highland meadows of Vagamon, the dramatic sea cliffs of Varkala, and the mangrove-lined coast near Alleppey. Perfect for those who want more than just the usual backwaters.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi
itinerary.description: Transfer to Kochi. Evening heritage walk through Fort Kochi — Dutch Palace, Chinese fishing nets, and Jew Town.

itinerary.title: Drive to Vagamon
itinerary.description: Drive to Vagamon (120km). Check into a tree-house or meadow stay. Sunset jeep off-roading through the pine forests.

itinerary.title: Hidden Waterfall Trek
itinerary.description: Guided trek through the Vagamon hills to a hidden seasonal waterfall. Swimming in the natural pool. Evening campfire.

itinerary.title: Varkala Cliffs
itinerary.description: Drive down to Varkala. Afternoon at the dramatic red cliff beach. Sunset at the Janardanaswamy Temple on the headland.

itinerary.title: Mangrove Boat Ride
itinerary.description: Sunrise mangrove boat safari near Alleppey. Explore the narrow waterways by canoe. Afternoon at leisure on houseboat.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Kochi / Trivandrum airport.

packages.title: Tea Trails & Backwater Tales
packages.subtitle: Kerala Classic
packages.short_description: Spice gardens of Munnar to luxury houseboats of Alleppey
packages.description: The definitive Kerala journey — from the emerald tea estates of Munnar to the tranquil backwaters of Alleppey, with a dose of culture in Kochi and spiritual vibrance in Thekkady. This 7-day package is Kerala at its most quintessential.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi
itinerary.description: Fort Kochi heritage walk. Chinese fishermen. Dutch Palace. Kathakali show in the evening.

itinerary.title: Drive to Munnar
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through tea-carpeted hills. Visit a tea factory and do a guided tea tasting session.

itinerary.title: Munnar Exploration
itinerary.description: Eravikulam National Park (Nilgiri Tahr). Echo Point. Mattupetty Dam. Top Station sunset.

itinerary.title: Thekkady — Spice & Wildlife
itinerary.description: Drive to Thekkady. Periyar boat ride for elephant & bison spotting. Spice plantation walk with chef demo.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.description: Luxury houseboat check-in. Afternoon cruising canals. Fresh Kerala meals. Overnight on the backwaters.

itinerary.title: Backwaters to Kovalam
itinerary.description: Morning canoe through narrow channels. Drive to Kovalam beach. Evening leisure at the lighthouse beach.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Trivandrum airport.

packages.title: Havelock & Neil Island Explorer
packages.subtitle: Island Hopping Paradise
packages.short_description: Turquoise waters, coral reefs & tropical island vibes
packages.description: The Andaman Islands are India's best-kept secret — pristine beaches to rival the Maldives, vibrant coral at Elephant Beach, and the serene beauty of Neil Island. This 5-day journey covers the highlights of Havelock and Neil Island with scuba diving, snorkeling, and glass-bottom boat rides.

itinerary.title: Port Blair Arrival
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel. Evening at Corbyn's Cove beach. Cellular Jail Sound & Light Show.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Havelock (Radhanagar Beach)
itinerary.description: Ferry to Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep). Afternoon at Radhanagar Beach — Asia's best beach. Sunset views from the cliff.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach & Scuba
itinerary.description: Glass-bottom boat or speedboat to Elephant Beach. Snorkeling over coral reefs. Optional scuba diving intro session. Afternoon free.

itinerary.title: Neil Island Day
itinerary.description: Ferry to Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep). Visit Natural Rock (Bridge) formation. Laxmanpur Beach sunset. Serene island lunch.

itinerary.title: Return & Departure
itinerary.description: Ferry back to Port Blair. Airport transfer.

packages.title: Andaman Heritage & Sunset Soul
packages.subtitle: History Meets Tranquility
packages.short_description: Cellular Jail, scuba diving & magical Chidiya Tapu sunsets
packages.description: A perfect blend of colonial history and tropical paradise. Visit the hauntingly beautiful Cellular Jail, explore submarine life with scuba diving, and watch the most legendary sunset in India at Chidiya Tapu. Our most popular 6-day Andaman package.

itinerary.title: Port Blair Arrival
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel. Evening Cellular Jail Sound & Light Show.

itinerary.title: Ross Island & North Bay
itinerary.description: Ferry to Ross Island (colonial ruins, deer, and peacocks). Glass-bottom boat at North Bay Coral Park. Afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: Havelock Scuba
itinerary.description: Ferry to Havelock. Scuba diving morning session. Afternoon at Radhanagar Beach.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Jet ski ride to Elephant Beach. Snorkeling with vibrant coral and fish. Afternoon at Kalapathar Beach.

itinerary.title: Neil Island & Chidiya Tapu
itinerary.description: Day trip to Neil Island for natural rock formation. Return to Port Blair for the legendary sunset at Chidiya Tapu (Bird Island).

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Port Blair airport.

packages.title: Kashmir Family Grandeur
packages.subtitle: Heaven on Earth — Family Edition
packages.short_description: Houseboats, Gondola rides & snowy Gulmarg meadows
packages.description: Kashmir needs no introduction. This family-oriented tour is designed so that every member — grandparents, parents, and children — can experience the magic of "Paradise on Earth" comfortably and safely. From shikara rides on the mirror-calm Dal Lake to gondola rides in Gulmarg and the verdant Betaab Valley, every day is a postcard moment.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Check into your traditional houseboat on Dal Lake. Evening shikara ride watching the mountains fade into gold.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Mughal Gardens (Shalimar, Nishat, Chashme Shahi). Hazratbal Shrine. Floating vegetable market by shikara.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg — Meadow of Flowers
itinerary.description: Drive to Gulmarg (56km). Gondola Phase 1 & 2 (cable car). Snow activities in season. Pony ride in the meadow. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam — Valley of Shepherds
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam. Betaab Valley (from DDLJ!). Aru Village. Chandanwari meadow. Lidder River walk.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg — Meadow of Gold
itinerary.description: Drive to Sonmarg. Thajiwas Glacier pony ride. Sindh River picnic. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Local Srinagar
itinerary.description: Old City walk — Jama Masjid, copper market. Lal Chowk shopping. Evening royal bonfire at the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Saffron & dry fruit shopping. Transfer to airport.

packages.title: Leh & High Altitudes Explorer
packages.subtitle: Spiritual Ladakh
packages.short_description: Shanti Stupa, Nubra Valley & ancient monasteries
packages.description: This is the essential Ladakh experience — acclimatize in Leh, explore spiritual monasteries atop dramatic ridges, cross Khardung La into the Nubra Valley and ride double-humped Bactrian camels on the sand dunes before reaching the iconic Pangong Tso lake, where the sky meets the water in an infinite azure.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Leh airport pickup. Full rest + light stroll to Shanti Stupa. Briefing dinner.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Leh Palace. Hall of Fame. Magnetic Hill. Sangam (Indus-Zanskar confluence). Patthar Sahib Gurudwara.

itinerary.title: Monastery Circuit
itinerary.description: Thiksey Monastery (mini Potala). Hemis Monastery. Shey Palace. Druk Padma Karpo School (3 Idiots!). Rancho Wall photo.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.description: Drive over Khardung La (5,359m — world's highest motorable pass). Arrive in Nubra. Diskit Monastery. Bactrian camel safari at Hunder sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso
itinerary.description: Drive via Shyok Valley (spectacular). Arrive at Pangong Lake. Evening at the surreal blue lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh
itinerary.description: Sunrise at Pangong Tso. Drive back via Chang La. Farewell dinner in Leh.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Early transfer to Leh airport.

packages.title: Pangong Soul & Siachen Frontier
packages.subtitle: Eastern Ladakh Expedition
packages.short_description: Overnight at Pangong Tso & Siachen Base Camp visit
packages.description: Go where very few travelers dare — deep into the eastern frontiers of Ladakh to spend multiple nights at the iconic Pangong Tso and make a landmark approach to the Siachen Base Camp via the Nubra Valley. This is an adventure for those who want more than the standard Ladakh circuit.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Leh airport. Rest. Acclimatization walk. Briefing.

itinerary.title: Leh Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Thiksey Monastery. Hemis. Leh Palace. Local market.

itinerary.title: Leh to Pangong Tso
itinerary.description: Drive via Chang La Pass (5,360m) to Pangong. Arrive for sunset.

itinerary.title: Full Day at Pangong
itinerary.description: Sunrise photography. Kayaking session on the lake (seasonal). Drive along the southern bank for different perspectives.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Nubra
itinerary.description: Drive via Agham-Shyok road. Arrive Nubra Valley. Diskit Monastery & Bactrian camel ride.

itinerary.title: Siachen Base Camp Visit
itinerary.description: Drive beyond Panamik to approach Siachen Base Camp area (permit required). Fascinating glacial terrain and army insights.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Leh via Khardung La
itinerary.description: Cross Khardung La (5,359m). Farewell dinner in Leh.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Leh airport.

packages.title: Sikkim Silk Route & High Passes
packages.subtitle: East Sikkim Adventure
packages.short_description: Tsomgo Lake, Nathula Pass & the ancient Silk Route
packages.description: Trace the ancient Silk Route through East Sikkim's most spectacular landscapes. This 6-day tour takes you from the glacial Tsomgo Lake to the Indo-China border at Nathula Pass, through the remote Zuluk switchbacks and across the legendary old trading route between India and Tibet.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel. Evening at MG Marg. Briefing dinner.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo & Baba Mandir
itinerary.description: Drive to Tsomgo Lake (3,753m) — glacial lake shimmering in emerald. Visit Baba Mandir (army shrine). Yak ride option.

itinerary.title: Nathula Pass
itinerary.description: Drive to Nathula Pass (4,310m — India-China border). Dramatic views. Return via Tsomgo for lunch.

itinerary.title: Zuluk Spiral Road
itinerary.description: Drive to Zuluk via the famous 32-switchback spiral road. Overnight in a mountain homestay.

itinerary.title: Silk Route Exploration
itinerary.description: Drive through Lungthung and Thambi View Point (Mt. Kanchenjunga panorama). Return to Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to NJP/Bagdogra.

packages.title: North Sikkim Wilderness & Wonders
packages.subtitle: Gurudongmar & Zero Point
packages.short_description: Sunrise at one of the world's highest lakes
packages.description: North Sikkim is the last great frontier — remote, pristine, and overwhelming in its natural grandeur. This 7-day expedition takes you to the sacred Gurudongmar Lake (5,430m), one of the world's highest lakes, and beyond to "Zero Point," where civilization ends and the raw Himalayas begin.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Transfer. Evening at MG Marg. Local Sikkimese dinner.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Rumtek Monastery. Enchey Monastery. Do-Drul Chorten. Ropeway.

itinerary.title: Drive to Lachen
itinerary.description: Drive through Teesta Valley, Chungthang waterfall. Arrive Lachen homestay.

itinerary.title: Gurudongmar Lake
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn drive to Gurudongmar Lake (5,430m). Sacred lake that never freezes completely. Return to Lachen for rest.

itinerary.title: Lachen to Lachung
itinerary.description: Drive to Lachung via Chungthang. Afternoon free at this beautiful mountain village.

itinerary.title: Yumthang & Zero Point
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Yumthang Valley (rhododendrons). Drive to Zero Point (4,800m) — northernmost tip of Sikkim. Return to Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to NJP/Bagdogra.

packages.title: Bhutan: Kingdom of Clouds
packages.subtitle: 8-Day Bhutan Circuit
packages.short_description: Dzongs, valleys & the land of Gross National Happiness
packages.description: Bhutan is unlike anywhere else on Earth — a kingdom that measures success in happiness rather than GDP, where ancient Dzong fortresses guard misty river valleys, and where a visit to a "Fertility Temple" is a cultural must. This 8-day comprehensive circuit covers Phuentsholing, Thimphu, the stunning Punakha Dzong, Paro, and the offbeat Phobjikha Valley.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Phuentsholing
itinerary.description: Cross the border from India. Check into hotel. Evening walk at the Bhutan Gate.

itinerary.title: Drive to Thimphu
itinerary.description: Drive to the Bhutanese capital (176km). Visit Tashichhoe Dzong. Folk Heritage Museum. Buddha Dordenma statue.

itinerary.title: Thimphu Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Simply Bhutan Museum (interactive). Takin Preserve. National Memorial Chorten. Textile Museum. Local market.

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha
itinerary.description: Cross Dochu La Pass (3,100m — 108 chortens). Phobjikha Valley diversion. Arrive Punakha.

itinerary.title: Punakha Dzong & Chimi Lhakhang
itinerary.description: Punakha Dzong (most beautiful fortress monastery). Walk to Chimi Lhakhang "Fertility Temple." Suspension bridge — longest in Bhutan.

itinerary.title: Punakha to Paro
itinerary.description: Drive to Paro. Rinpung Dzong. National Museum. Paro town stroll.

itinerary.title: Tiger's Nest Hike
