itinerary.description: Morning hike to Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest Monastery) — the most iconic image in Bhutan. 4-hour round trip through pine forest and prayer flags.

itinerary.title: Departure from Paro
itinerary.description: Handicrafts shopping. Transfer to Paro airport or Phuentsholing border.

packages.title: Himalayan Happiness & Tiger's Nest
packages.subtitle: Bhutan Spiritual Highlights
packages.short_description: Paro Taktsang hike, Kharbandi Gompa & local handicraft nights
packages.description: A focused, deeply spiritual Bhutan experience built around the country's most iconic pilgrimage — the hike to Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest). This 5-day package captures the essence of Bhutan's spiritual heart in an intimate format, perfect for those who want quality over quantity.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuentsholing
itinerary.description: Border crossing. Hotel check-in. Evening at Bhutan Gate and local market walk.

itinerary.title: Drive to Paro
itinerary.description: Drive to Paro via stunning river valley. Visit Rinpung Dzong. Afternoon free in charming Paro town.

itinerary.title: Tiger's Nest Hike
itinerary.description: Full-day hike to Paro Taktsang Monastery. This cliff-face monastery at 3,120m is the most spiritual site in Bhutan. Packed lunch at the viewpoint. Return by afternoon.

itinerary.title: Kharbandi & Local Markets
itinerary.description: Morning at Kharbandi Gompa for sunrise views over Paro Valley. Afternoon in local handicraft markets — thangka paintings, hand-woven textiles, incense.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Paro Airport or Phuentsholing border.

packages.title: Spiti Circuit: Manali to Chandratal
packages.subtitle: 6 Nights / 7 Days
packages.short_description: World's highest post office, fossils & moonlight camping at Chandratal
packages.description: The ultimate Spiti loop — starting from Manali through the Atal Tunnel into the cold desert. This 7-day circuit packs in the 1,000-year-old Key Monastery, the world's highest post office in Hikkim, fossil hunting at Langza, and a breathtaking night under the Milky Way at the Moon Lake — Chandratal.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kaza
itinerary.description: Drive via Atal Tunnel (Rohtang). Through Gramphu, Losar. Arrive Kaza town.

itinerary.title: Key Monastery & Kibber
itinerary.description: 1000-year-old Key Gompa. Kibber (world's highest village with a road). Ki-Ber Wildlife Sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Hikkim, Langza & Komic
itinerary.description: Post card from world's highest post office (Hikkim). Fossil hunting in Langza. Komic (highest inhabited village with a road).

itinerary.title: Pin Valley
itinerary.description: Pin Valley National Park — habitat of snow leopard and Ibex. Mud village exploration.

itinerary.title: Dhankar & Tabo
itinerary.description: Cliffside Dhankar Monastery. Sacred Tabo Monastery (UNESCO — Ajanta of the Himalayas, 1000 years old).

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal
itinerary.description: Drive over Kunzum Pass (4,590m). Trek 1.5km to the crescent-shaped Chandratal (Moon Lake). Camping.

itinerary.title: Back to Manali
itinerary.description: Early morning walk at Chandratal. Drive back over Rohtang/Atal Tunnel to Manali.

packages.title: Himalayan Gateway: Shimla to Spiti
packages.subtitle: 6 Nights / 7 Days
packages.short_description: Kinnaur Valley, Chitkul & the mummy at Gue
packages.description: The Shimla-to-Spiti route is the more dramatic, more scenic approach — a gradual climb through the lush Kinnaur Valley and its apple orchards, past the last village of India at Chitkul, and into the stark, ochre moonscape of Spiti. This route also features one of India's most remarkable hidden gems: the 500-year-old naturally mummified monk at Gue.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Narkanda
itinerary.description: Drive through apple country. Hatu Peak views. Overnight Narkanda.

itinerary.title: Narkanda to Sangla
itinerary.description: Rampur Bushahr. Enter beautiful Kinnaur Valley. Sangla's dramatic gorge.

itinerary.title: Chitkul — Last Village of India
itinerary.description: Drive to Chitkul (3,450m), the last Indian village before the Tibet border. Baspa River. Apple orchards. Tibetan culture.

itinerary.title: Sangla to Kalpa
itinerary.description: Stunning drive to Kalpa with views of Kinner Kailash (6,050m). Suicide Point. Evening walk in the apple village.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Nako & Gue
itinerary.description: Drive to Nako Lake. Stop at Gue to see the 500-year-old uncorrupted mummy of a Buddhist monk. Arrive Kaza.

itinerary.title: Spiti Monasteries
itinerary.description: Key Monastery, Kibber, and Langza fossil village. Overnight Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Manali
itinerary.description: Drive back via Kunzum Pass or Atal Tunnel to Manali. End of tour.

exclusions: Train to Shimla / flight to Chandigarh

packages.title: Island Essence & Heritage Trail
packages.subtitle: Sri Lanka Complete Circuit
packages.short_description: Kandy temples, Ella trains & Galle Fort by the sea
packages.description: Sri Lanka packs more beauty per square kilometer than almost anywhere else — lush highlands carpeted in tea, ancient kingdoms carved into rock, elephants bathing in jungle rivers, and colonial port cities facing emerald seas. This 7-day all-inclusive circuit is the definitive Sri Lanka experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Colombo
itinerary.description: Airport transfer to Negombo for a day at leisure. Beach walk. Seafood dinner by the lagoon.

itinerary.title: Kandy — Temple City
itinerary.description: Drive to Kandy. Temple of the Tooth Relic. Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens. Traditional Kandyan dance show.

itinerary.title: Kandy to Ella by Train
itinerary.description: The most scenic train ride in the world — through tea estates, misty valleys, and the famous Nine Arch Bridge at Demodara.

itinerary.title: Ella Hikes
itinerary.description: Hike to Little Adam's Peak. Ravana Waterfall. Nine Arch Bridge photo walk. Evening free in Ella town.

itinerary.title: Udawalawe Elephant Safari
itinerary.description: Morning safari at Udawalawe National Park — the best place in Asia for wild elephant sightings. Afternoon drive to Galle.

itinerary.title: Galle Fort & Bentota Beach
itinerary.description: Walk through 17th-century UNESCO-listed Galle Fort — Dutch colonial architecture, cafés, and lighthouse. Afternoon at serene Bentota Beach.

itinerary.title: Return to Colombo & Departure
itinerary.description: Drive to Colombo. City highlights — Gangaramaya Temple, Pettah Market. Airport drop.

inclusions: 6 nights in 3-4 star hotels (Negombo 1N, Kandy 1N, Ella 2N, Galle/Bentota 2N)
Kandy to Ella scenic train tickets

packages.title: Rishikesh & Mussoorie Family Trip
packages.subtitle: Spiritual Serenity & Hill Station Charm
packages.short_description: Ganga Aarti, Kempty Falls & Mall Road — the perfect family escape
packages.description: A perfectly crafted family getaway combining the spiritual tranquility of Rishikesh with the colonial charm of Mussoorie. Begin your journey along the banks of the holy Ganges, witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat, and then ascend to the Queen of Hills for panoramic mountain views, cascading waterfalls, and bustling Mall Road shopping. This 4-day package includes comfortable accommodation, daily breakfast & dinner, and all transfers by private Ertiga cab from Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi → Rishikesh (240 KM / 6–7 Hrs)
itinerary.description: Pickup from Delhi and drive towards the spiritual town of Rishikesh, nestled along the banks of the Ganges. Upon arrival, check-in at hotel/camp and relax. Later visit Ram Jhula, Laxman Jhula, and attend the evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat. Overnight stay in Rishikesh. Meals: Dinner.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh → Mussoorie (75 KM / 2–3 Hrs)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out and drive towards Mussoorie, known as the Queen of Hills. Upon arrival, check-in at hotel and relax. Evening visit Mall Road Mussoorie and Gun Hill. Enjoy shopping and local food. Overnight stay in Mussoorie. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for full-day sightseeing. Visit Kempty Falls, Company Garden Mussoorie, Camel's Back Road, and Mussoorie Lake. Return to hotel by evening. Overnight stay in Mussoorie. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie → Delhi Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out and drive back to Delhi for drop at Railway Station / Airport. Tour ends with beautiful family memories. Meals: Breakfast.

inclusions: Accommodation in mentioned hotels/camp (The Shore / Riverside Camp in Rishikesh, Midtown / Ashirwad in Mussoorie)
01 Room + 01 Extra Bed + 01 Kid under 5 complimentary
All sightseeing & transfers by Ertiga cab
Driver allowance, toll tax, parking & fuel charges
exclusions: Any expenses due to weather or road conditions

packages.title: Shimla & Manali Family Package
packages.subtitle: Snow-Capped Mountains & Beautiful Lakes
packages.short_description: Kufri adventures, Solang Valley thrills & Himalayan serenity
packages.description: Crafted to ensure a perfect getaway with your loved ones amongst snow-clad mountains and beautiful lakes. This 6-day journey takes you from the colonial charm of Shimla — with its Rashtrapati Niwas, Kufri snow point, and the Mall Road bustle — to the adventure paradise of Manali, where Solang Valley, Rohtang views, and the old-world charm of Naggar Palace await. Relax, explore, worship, adventure, shop, and bond — this package covers it all.

itinerary.title: Arrival – Shimla: Welcome to the Queen of Hills
itinerary.description: Start your memorable journey with a comfortable transfer to Shimla. Experience a picturesque drive indulged with the beauty of lakes bounded by mountains on the way. On your arrival to Shimla, check in to the pre-booked hotel, relax and get yourself ready to explore the famous places of Shimla. Overnight stay and dinner.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Head towards the highest point in Shimla. Visit Rashtrapati Niwas — popularly known for its British architecture, paintings, furniture and artifacts. Enjoy evening time in Kufri; explore the diverse wildlife at the Himalayan zoo. Return back to the hotel in Shimla for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali – Welcome to the Valley of Gods
itinerary.description: Start your day with a healthy breakfast at the hotel in Shimla followed by check-out formalities and head towards Manali. Distance: Approx. 6 hrs 56 min (232.5 kms). Enjoy the view of tall mountains on both the sides and capture some part of it as a memory. Check in to the hotel in Manali, relax and enjoy dinner.

itinerary.title: Full Day Excursion to Manali
itinerary.description: Day starts with a delicious breakfast and local sightseeing in Manali. Visit US Club, Naggar Palace, Tibetan Monastery (sightseeing will depend as per time allows). Evening at leisure to visit the market area. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Fun Day at Solang Valley
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisure morning walk followed by breakfast. Head to Solang Valley for adventure activities like paragliding and skiing (at own cost). Note: Rohtang Pass is closed Nov–May; people visit Solang Valley instead. Also closed on Tuesdays. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure – Tour End
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and relax for some time. The package ends once you reach Volvo stand Manali. But the time spent with your family and Nature Marvels of Himachal will always remain in your memories.

inclusions: Transfers: Shimla, Shimla-Manali, Manali by cab (Swift Dzire)
All sightseeing as per itinerary by cab
Accommodation: Deluxe Room (Ashoka In / Jaku Vibes / Solitude Inn in Shimla, Taragarh Palace / Marina Heights in Manali)
exclusions: Charge for early check-in / late checkout
Personal expenses like shopping, phone, laundry etc.
Sightseeing places entry pass (subject to availability)
Any charges due to weather conditions / natural activities or delay in flights/train/bus

packages.title: Udaipur & Mount Abu Family Tour
packages.subtitle: City of Lakes & Rajasthan's Only Hill Station
packages.short_description: Royal palaces, marble temples & serene Nakki Lake sunsets
packages.description: A regal family journey through the Venice of the East and Rajasthan's only hill station. Explore the magnificent City Palace of Udaipur, enjoy sunset boat rides on Lake Pichola, marvel at the exquisite marble carvings of Dilwara Temples in Mount Abu, and soak in the peaceful vibes of Nakki Lake. This 5-day tour combines royal heritage with natural beauty, making it the perfect family escape to Rajasthan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Udaipur – Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Arrival at Udaipur, also known as the City of Lakes. Upon arrival, check into the hotel (Revaas Lake Boutique Hotel) and relax. Later proceed for sightseeing covering City Palace, Jagdish Temple, and Saheliyon ki Bari. Evening free for leisure or optional boating at Lake Pichola. Overnight stay: Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Udaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue sightseeing in Udaipur covering Fateh Sagar Lake, Moti Magri, and Sajjangarh Palace (Monsoon Palace). Evening free for shopping and leisure. Overnight stay: Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Udaipur to Mount Abu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and drive to Mount Abu, the only hill station of Rajasthan. Upon arrival, check into the hotel (Hotel Royal Palace). In the evening, visit Nakki Lake and enjoy sunset views from Sunset Point. Overnight stay: Mount Abu.

itinerary.title: Mount Abu Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for sightseeing covering Dilwara Temples, famous for exquisite marble carvings. Also visit Guru Shikhar (highest peak in Rajasthan) and Brahma Kumaris Peace Park. Overnight stay: Mount Abu.

itinerary.title: Mount Abu to Udaipur Drop
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive back to Udaipur for departure. Tour ends with beautiful memories.

inclusions: Accommodation in mentioned hotels (Revaas Lake Boutique Hotel, Udaipur & Hotel Royal Palace, Mount Abu)
1 Room with 1 Extra Bed & 1 CNB (Child No Bed)
All sightseeing and transfers by private vehicle

packages.title: Mussoorie, Nainital & Rishikesh Family Tour
packages.subtitle: Triple Hill Station Delight
packages.short_description: Queen of Hills, City of Lakes & Yoga Capital in one epic trip
packages.description: The ultimate North India family hill station tour covering three iconic destinations in one seamless journey. Start with the spiritual vibes of Rishikesh and the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti, ascend to the Queen of Hills — Mussoorie — for Kempty Falls and Gun Hill views, then travel to the enchanting City of Lakes — Nainital — for boating on Naini Lake and panoramic views from Snow View Point. This comprehensive 6-day package includes comfortable stays, daily breakfast & dinner, and all transfers by private sedan from Delhi.

itinerary.title: Arrival Delhi – Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Arrival at Dehradun Airport / Railway Station. Drive to Rishikesh. Evening sightseeing: Ram Jhula, Laxman Jhula, Triveni Ghat, and Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh → Mussoorie
itinerary.description: Breakfast & check-out. Drive to Mussoorie. Check-in at hotel (Midtown / Ashirwad). Evening free to explore Mall Road. Overnight stay in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Visit Kempty Falls, Gun Hill (by ropeway – optional), Camel's Back Road, Company Garden, and Mussoorie Lake. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie → Nainital (290 km / 8–9 hrs)
itinerary.description: Breakfast & check-out. Scenic drive to Nainital. En-route short breaks for refreshments. Arrival & check-in at hotel (Cedarwoods / Dynasty). Evening free for Naini Lake walk. Overnight stay in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Sightseeing includes Naini Lake (Boating – optional), Naina Devi Temple, Snow View Point (Cable car – optional), Tiffin Top, Eco Cave Garden, Mall Road & Tibetan Market. Overnight stay in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital → Delhi Drop
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Drive back to Delhi Airport / Railway Station. Tour ends with sweet memories.

inclusions: Accommodation in well-rated hotels (The Shore / Riverside Camp in Rishikesh, Midtown / Ashirwad in Mussoorie, Cedarwoods / Dynasty in Nainital)
Daily breakfast & dinner at all hotels
All transfers & sightseeing by private Sedan
Rishikesh, Mussoorie & Nainital sightseeing as mentioned
Toll tax, parking, fuel & driver allowance

packages.title: Turkey: Cappadocia & Istanbul Magic
packages.subtitle: Where East Meets West
packages.short_description: Hot air balloons, Ottoman grandeur & turquoise coasts
packages.description: Turkey is one of the world's great crossroads — where the domed skyline of Istanbul's mosques meets the fairy-chimney valleys of Cappadocia, where hot air balloons drift at sunrise over honeycombed rock formations, and where turquoise Aegean coves glitter beside ancient ruins. This 7-day journey captures the very best of Turkey in one unforgettable arc.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel in Sultanahmet. Evening Bosphorus sunset walk along the European shore. Welcome dinner of meze and kebabs near the Grand Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Classics
itinerary.description: Morning at the Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmet Camii) and Hagia Sophia. Guided tour of Topkapi Palace and the Harem. Afternoon at the Grand Bazaar. Evening Bosphorus dinner cruise.

itinerary.title: Dolmabahçe & Spice Bazaar
itinerary.description: Visit the opulent Dolmabahçe Palace — the last residence of Ottoman sultans. Spice Bazaar for Turkish delight, saffron, and baklava. Afternoon free in Galata and Beyoğlu.

itinerary.title: Fly to Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Kayseri/Nevşehir. Transfer to Göreme. Afternoon exploration of Göreme Open Air Museum (UNESCO). Sunset from Love Valley viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Hot Air Balloon
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn hot air balloon flight over Cappadocia's fairy chimneys and valleys — the highlight of the trip. Champagne breakfast after landing. Afternoon underground city of Derinkuyu. Evening Turkish pottery class.

itinerary.title: Rose Valley & Ihlara
itinerary.description: Guided hike through the Rose Valley and Red Valley. Visit Uçhisar Castle for panoramic views. Afternoon at Ihlara Valley canyon walk. Traditional Turkish bath (hammam) in the evening.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free — last minute shopping for hand-painted ceramics and kilim rugs. Transfer to Kayseri airport. Departure.

inclusions: 6 nights in 4-star hotels (Istanbul 3N, Cappadocia cave hotel 3N)
Hot air balloon flight with champagne breakfast
Topkapi Palace & Hagia Sophia guided tour
Underground city & Göreme Open Air Museum

packages.title: Egypt: Pharaohs & Nile Wonders
packages.subtitle: The Cradle of Civilisation
packages.short_description: Great Pyramids, Valley of the Kings & a 5-star Nile cruise
packages.description: Egypt is humankind's greatest open-air museum — where the last surviving Wonder of the Ancient World still stands, where mummies of pharaohs sleep in gilded tombs, and where the world's longest river carves a green ribbon of life through an infinite golden desert. This 7-day journey delivers the full Egypt experience: Cairo's grandeur, Luxor's temples, and a 5-star Nile cruise between Luxor and Aswan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Transfer to your hotel near the pyramids. Evening welcome dinner at a Nile-view restaurant. Orientation briefing.

itinerary.title: Giza Pyramids & Egyptian Museum
itinerary.description: Morning visit to the Great Pyramid of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Solar Boat Museum — the most iconic images in human history. Afternoon at the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), the world's largest archaeological museum. Evening light show at the pyramids.

itinerary.title: Cairo Old City
itinerary.description: Explore Islamic Cairo — Khan el-Khalili Bazaar, Al-Azhar Mosque, and the Citadel of Saladin. Afternoon at Coptic Cairo — the Hanging Church and Ben Ezra Synagogue. Evening flight to Luxor.

itinerary.title: Luxor East Bank
itinerary.description: Karnak Temple Complex — the largest religious site ever built. Luxor Temple illuminated at sunset. Board your 5-star Nile cruise ship for overnight.

itinerary.title: Valley of the Kings & Cruise Sail
itinerary.description: Sunrise Valley of the Kings — enter the tombs of Ramesses II and Tutankhamun. Hatshepsut Temple at Deir el-Bahari. Memnon Colossi. Sail south towards Edfu through the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Edfu, Kom Ombo & Aswan
itinerary.description: Morning at the Temple of Horus at Edfu (best-preserved temple in Egypt). Afternoon at the double temple of Kom Ombo. Arrive Aswan. Felucca sail around Elephantine Island at sunset.

itinerary.title: Aswan & Departure
itinerary.description: Abu Simbel excursion (optional, early morning). Philae Temple on island. High Dam. Transfer to Aswan airport for return flight to Cairo and international departure.

inclusions: 3 nights in Cairo 5-star hotel + 3 nights on 5-star Nile cruise
All meals on Nile cruise (full board)

packages.title: South Korea: Seoul, Jeju & K-Culture
packages.subtitle: Land of Morning Calm
packages.short_description: Royal palaces, volcanic islands & the K-pop universe
packages.description: South Korea is a destination that surprises at every turn — centuries-old royal palaces sit beside neon-lit gaming cafes, ancient Buddhist temples perch on mountainsides above K-pop billboard districts, and the volcanic island of Jeju offers emerald coastlines and UNESCO lava tube caves. This 6-day journey blends the electric energy of Seoul with the volcanic beauty of Jeju Island in a perfectly paced experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Seoul
itinerary.description: Transfer to Myeongdong hotel. Evening street food walk — tteokbokki, hotteok, and Korean fried chicken. Visit the glittering Cheonggyecheon stream.

itinerary.title: Seoul Royal Heritage
itinerary.description: Gyeongbokgung Palace with Changing of the Guard ceremony. Bukchon Hanok Village — 600-year-old traditional Korean houses. Insadong for crafts and tea. N Seoul Tower for city panorama at sunset.

itinerary.title: K-Pop & Modern Seoul
itinerary.description: Gangnam district exploration — COEX Mall, SM Entertainment HQ. K-Pop dance class experience. Afternoon at Lotte World and Seokchon Lake. Evening market in Hongdae.

itinerary.title: DMZ & Han River
itinerary.description: Morning guided DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) tour — the most tense border on earth, with tunnel exploration and Dorasan Station. Afternoon Han River picnic. Evening Namsangol Hanok Village.

itinerary.title: Jeju Island
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Jeju Island. Visit Hallasan National Park. Afternoon at Jeju Olle Trail coastal walk. Manjanggul Lava Tube UNESCO site. Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak) at sunset.

itinerary.title: Jeju & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at Hyeopjae Beach — emerald sea against black lava rock. Teddy Bear Museum. Haenyeo (woman diver) demonstration. Return flight to Seoul and international departure.

packages.title: Oman: Desert, Wadis & Forts
packages.subtitle: Arabia's Best-Kept Secret
packages.short_description: Grand Mosque, Wahiba Sands & Wadi Shab emerald gorge
packages.description: Oman is the Middle East as it once was — warm, genuine, spectacularly beautiful, and blissfully uncrowded. The Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque is one of the world's most breathtaking religious buildings. Wadi Shab's emerald gorge hides a secret waterfall cave accessible only by swimming. The Wahiba Sands dunes glow amber at sunset. And the ancient souk of Mutrah fills the air with frankincense. This 5-day journey captures Oman's magic in an intimate, unhurried format.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Muscat
itinerary.description: Transfer to your hotel near the Royal Opera House. Evening walk along the Mutrah Corniche at sunset. Dinner at a traditional Omani restaurant.

itinerary.title: Muscat Highlights
itinerary.description: Visit the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque — one of the world's most beautiful. Mutrah Souk for frankincense, silver, and khanjars. Al Jalali and Al Mirani Forts. Royal Opera House tour. Evening at the Muscat Festival waterfront.

itinerary.title: Nizwa Fort & Jabrin Castle
itinerary.description: Drive to Nizwa — the ancient capital of Oman. Nizwa Fort with its soaring circular tower. Nizwa Souk on a Friday (livestock market — extraordinary!). Afternoon at the perfectly preserved Jabrin Castle. Overnight at a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Wahiba Sands & Wadi Bani Khalid
itinerary.description: Morning 4WD dune bashing in the Wahiba Sands. Camel ride at sunrise. Breakfast at the desert camp. Afternoon swim in the natural rock pools of Wadi Bani Khalid — an oasis in the desert.

itinerary.title: Wadi Shab & Departure
itinerary.description: Boat ride into the dramatic Wadi Shab gorge. Walk through the canyon to a hidden waterfall cave (swimming required). Return to Muscat for afternoon departure.

inclusions: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque guided visit
Wadi Shab boat ride & gorge walk

packages.title: Singapore City Escape
packages.subtitle: The Lion City in 5 Days
packages.short_description: Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa thrills & Hawker Centre feasts
packages.description: Singapore is the world's most impeccably planned city — where a rainforest-inspired nature dome stands beside the world's highest infinity pool, and Michelin-starred food stalls serve $3 plates of char kway teow. This 5-day package covers every iconic experience: Gardens by the Bay, Universal Studios, the Singapore Night Safari, and the spectacular Jewel Changi waterfall.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Marina Bay Sands
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel near Marina Bay. Evening at the Marina Bay Sands Skypark Observation Deck. Witness the Garden Rhapsody light show at Gardens by the Bay.

itinerary.title: Gardens & Supertrees
itinerary.description: Morning in Flower Dome and Cloud Forest conservatories. Clarke Quay river cruise. Evening Supertree Grove light show with dinner at Satay by the Bay.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios & Sentosa
itinerary.description: Full day at Universal Studios Singapore. S.E.A. Aquarium. Siloso Beach. Evening cable car back with city views.

itinerary.title: Cultural Singapore
itinerary.description: Chinatown — Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Maxwell Food Centre. Little India. Kampong Glam — Sultan Mosque. Evening Orchard Road shopping.

itinerary.title: Jewel Changi & Departure
itinerary.description: Jewel Changi Airport — HSBC Rain Vortex (world's tallest indoor waterfall), Canopy Park. Last breakfast. Departure.

inclusions: 4 nights in 4-star Marina Bay area hotel

packages.title: Maldives Island Bliss
packages.subtitle: Indian Ocean Paradise
packages.short_description: Overwater villas, turquoise lagoons & whale shark safaris
packages.description: The Maldives delivers paradise in its purest form — 1,200 coral islands scattered across the Indian Ocean, each ringed by a lagoon of impossible turquoise. From the luxury overwater bungalows of North Malé Atoll to the budget-friendly local island of Maafushi where whale sharks cruise offshore, this package lets you experience the Maldives magic your way.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Speedboat Transfer
itinerary.description: Arrive at Malé International Airport. Speedboat to your island. Check-in. Sunset from the beach.

itinerary.title: Snorkeling & Sandbank
itinerary.description: Morning house reef snorkeling — turtles, rays, and reef fish. Afternoon private sandbank excursion for photos and tea.

itinerary.title: Whale Shark Safari
itinerary.description: Full-day boat trip for whale shark swimming (seasonal). Lunch on the boat. Sunset dolphin cruise.

itinerary.title: Morning Kayak & Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise kayaking around the island. Transfer to Malé for departure.

packages.title: Philippines: Cebu & Bohol Island Escape
packages.subtitle: The Heart of the Visayas
packages.short_description: Whale sharks in Oslob, Chocolate Hills & pristine Alona Beach
packages.description: Cebu is the Philippines' second city and gateway to some of the country's most extraordinary natural wonders. Swim alongside the world's largest fish — the gentle whale sharks of Oslob — before hopping to Bohol Island where 1,268 perfectly rounded Chocolate Hills rise from an emerald landscape, tiny tarsiers blink at you from strangler fig branches, and Alona Beach's coral reef drops away into an azure abyss. Cebu City's 500-year-old Magellan's Cross and the colourful Sinulog heritage round out a trip that covers everything from ancient history to world-class marine life.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cebu City
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel in Cebu City. Evening walk along the heritage district — Magellan's Cross, Basilica Minore del Santo Niño (oldest church in the Philippines). Welcome dinner of lechon (Cebu's famous roasted pig) at a local carinderia.

itinerary.title: Whale Shark Snorkelling in Oslob
itinerary.description: Early morning drive to Oslob (2.5 hrs south). Snorkel with gentle whale sharks in the open sea — an unmissable bucket-list experience. Afternoon at Tumalog Falls — a misty curtain waterfall in the jungle. Visit Sumilon Island sandbar. Return to Cebu City.

itinerary.title: Kawasan Falls & Canyoneering
itinerary.description: Drive to Badian (3 hrs). Begin Kawasan Falls canyoneering adventure — cliff jumping, cave swimming, and abseiling through three turquoise-green falls. Lunch at the falls. Return to Cebu.

itinerary.title: Cross to Bohol — Chocolate Hills
itinerary.description: Fast ferry to Tagbilaran, Bohol (2 hrs). Transfer to Carmen — the iconic Chocolate Hills viewpoint (1,268 conical limestone hills, brown in dry season like chocolate drops). Tarsier Sanctuary — spot the world's smallest primate. Loboc River cruise lunch. Check-in at Panglao Island resort.

itinerary.title: Alona Beach & Diving
itinerary.description: Full day at Alona Beach, Panglao Island — snorkelling and diving on the house reef with sea turtles, clownfish, and parrotfish. Panglao lighthouse walk. Optional: Balicasag Island boat trip for spinner dolphins and manta rays. Sunset seafood BBQ on the beach.

itinerary.title: Bohol & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free at the beach. Transfer to Tagbilaran Airport. Fly back to Cebu for international connection, or depart direct. Departure.

inclusions: 5 nights (Cebu City hotel 3N, Panglao beachfront resort 2N)
exclusions: International flights (via Manila or direct to Cebu)

packages.title: Philippines: Palawan & El Nido
packages.subtitle: Island Paradise Awaits
packages.short_description: Limestone karsts, secret lagoons & world-class coral reefs
packages.description: Palawan has been repeatedly named the world's best island — and one visit explains exactly why. Ancient limestone karsts rise from jade-green lagoons, UNESCO-listed underground rivers wind through cathedral caves, and coral reefs teeming with marine life stretch across crystal-clear waters. El Nido's island hopping, Puerto Princesa's underground river, and Coron's World War II shipwreck dives make this the ultimate tropical adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Puerto Princesa
itinerary.description: Fly into Puerto Princesa. Transfer to your beachfront hotel. Welcome dinner of fresh seafood and Filipino BBQ.

itinerary.title: Puerto Princesa Underground River
itinerary.description: UNESCO World Heritage underground river tour — paddle through a 8.2km cave system with soaring chambers and wildlife. Afternoon at Honda Bay island hopping (Starfish Island, Cowrie Island).

itinerary.title: Transfer to El Nido
itinerary.description: Scenic van transfer through Palawan's jungle highway. Afternoon free at El Nido town beach. Evening at rooftop bar overlooking the limestone cliffs.

itinerary.title: El Nido Island Hopping A
itinerary.description: Full-day island hopping — Big Lagoon, Small Lagoon (kayaking through mangrove channels), Secret Lagoon, 7 Commando Beach. Fresh lunch cooked on the boat.

itinerary.title: El Nido Island Hopping C
itinerary.description: Secret Beach (swim through a rock crevice), Shimizu Island snorkeling, Matinloc Shrine, Hidden Beach. End at Helicopter Island for sunset.

itinerary.title: El Nido & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free — kayak rentals or beach time. Afternoon fly back from El Nido or Puerto Princesa. Departure.

inclusions: El Nido Island Hopping Tours A & C
exclusions: International flights to Manila + domestic flights Manila–Palawan
Philippine e-Visa (not required for Indian passports under 30 days)

packages.title: Georgia: Tbilisi, Kazbegi & Wine Country
packages.subtitle: The Caucasus Crown Jewel
packages.short_description: Ancient cave cities, Caucasus peaks & 8,000-year-old wine traditions
packages.description: Georgia is one of Europe's best-kept secrets — a country where ancient cave monasteries cling to cliffsides above roaring rivers, the snow-capped Greater Caucasus peaks tower over flower-filled meadows, and 8,000 years of wine-making tradition fills every valley of Kakheti. Tbilisi's sulphur bath district, art nouveau balconied streets, and buzzing wine bars make it one of the world's most exciting emerging cities.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Transfer to your hotel in old town Tbilisi. Evening walk through Rustaveli Avenue, Freedom Square, and the Dezerter Bazaar. Rooftop dinner with views of the Mtkvari River.

itinerary.title: Tbilisi Old Town & Mtskheta
itinerary.description: Narikala Fortress and city views. Sulphur bath district at Abanotubani. Metekhi Church. Afternoon in Mtskheta — the ancient capital and UNESCO-listed Svetitskhoveli Cathedral. Evening wine bar in Tbilisi.

itinerary.title: Kazbegi — Gergeti Trinity Church
itinerary.description: Full-day trip to Kazbegi in the Greater Caucasus. 4WD drive up to the iconic Gergeti Trinity Church (2,170m) with Mount Kazbek (5,047m) behind it — Georgia's most famous image. Ananuri Fortress and Zhinvali Reservoir on the Georgian Military Highway.

itinerary.title: Uplistsikhe Cave City & Gori
itinerary.description: Uplistsikhe — a 3,000-year-old rock-hewn cave city with streets, temples, and a theatre carved into the clifftop. Gori city. Return via the Caucasus foothills.

itinerary.title: Kakheti Wine Region
itinerary.description: Full day in Kakheti — the soul of Georgian wine. Visit two family wineries for traditional qvevri (clay jar) wine tasting. Sighnaghi — the City of Love with panoramic vineyard views. Bodbe Monastery.

itinerary.title: Tbilisi & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free in Tbilisi — dry bridge flea market, Fabrika creative hub. Afternoon departure.

inclusions: 5 nights in Tbilisi old town boutique hotel
exclusions: Georgian visa (Indian passport — visa on arrival available)

packages.title: Iceland: Northern Lights & Golden Circle
packages.subtitle: Land of Fire and Ice
packages.short_description: Auroras, geysers, waterfalls & the Blue Lagoon
packages.description: Iceland is where the raw power of nature performs on the grandest stage — the Northern Lights dance across winter skies, geysers shoot boiling water 30 metres into the air, and volcanoes quietly steam beneath glaciers. The Golden Circle, South Coast, and Snæfellsnes Peninsula are among the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, and the Blue Lagoon's steaming turquoise waters are the world's most famous geothermal spa.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Reykjavik
itinerary.description: Transfer from Keflavik airport to Reykjavik. Afternoon in the colourful capital — Hallgrímskirkja church, Harpa Concert Hall, and Old Harbour. Evening Northern Lights hunt (October–March) or midnight sun walk (summer).

itinerary.title: Golden Circle
itinerary.description: Þingvellir National Park (UNESCO) — walk between the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates. Geysir geothermal area — watch Strokkur erupt every 5 minutes. Gullfoss — the "Golden Waterfall" plunging 32m into a gorge. Friðheimar tomato greenhouse lunch.

itinerary.title: South Coast
itinerary.description: Seljalandsfoss — walk behind the waterfall curtain. Skógafoss with its rainbow mists. Black sand beach at Reynisfjara with its basalt columns. Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon — floating icebergs and diamond ice beach.

itinerary.title: Snæfellsnes Peninsula
itinerary.description: Drive to the magical Snæfellsnes Peninsula — Snæfellsjökull glacier volcano (Jules Verne's "Journey to the Centre of the Earth"). Kirkjufell mountain. Arnarstapi lava arch coastline.

itinerary.title: Blue Lagoon & Reykjavik
itinerary.description: Afternoon at the world-famous Blue Lagoon geothermal spa — milky turquoise waters at 38°C surrounded by lava fields. Evening farewell dinner in Reykjavik.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Keflavik airport. Departure.

packages.title: Netherlands: Amsterdam & Tulip Fields
packages.subtitle: The Dutch Golden Age
packages.short_description: Canal houses, Keukenhof tulips & world-class museums
packages.description: Amsterdam is one of Europe's most romantic and culturally rich cities — a 17th-century canal ring lined with elegant gabled houses, world-class museums packed with Rembrandt and Van Gogh, and a laid-back café culture that makes every corner feel like a painting. Spring adds Keukenhof's seven million tulips, the windmills of Kinderdijk, and the cheese markets of Gouda to create one of Europe's most colourful experiences.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel in the historic canal district. Evening canal boat tour through the UNESCO-listed 17th-century ring. Welcome dinner at a Dutch brasserie.

itinerary.title: Museums & Canals
itinerary.description: Rijksmuseum — Rembrandt's Night Watch and Vermeer's Milkmaid. Van Gogh Museum — the world's largest Van Gogh collection. Anne Frank House. Afternoon Jordaan neighbourhood. Heineken Experience brewery tour.

itinerary.title: Keukenhof & Windmills
itinerary.description: Keukenhof Gardens — the world's largest flower garden with 7 million tulips (March–May). Windmills at Zaanse Schans. Traditional Dutch cheese tasting. Delft blue ceramics workshop.

itinerary.title: Haarlem & Volendam
itinerary.description: Haarlem's medieval market square and St. Bavo Cathedral. Volendam fishing village — traditional Dutch costumes and fresh herring. Cheese farm at Edam. Evening back in Amsterdam.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free — Albert Cuyp market, Vondelpark cycle. Afternoon departure from Schiphol.

packages.title: Germany: Berlin, Bavaria & Neuschwanstein
packages.subtitle: From Imperial Berlin to Fairy-Tale Castles
packages.short_description: Cold War history, Oktoberfest, and the world's most famous castle
packages.description: Germany packs extraordinary variety into a single trip — Berlin where Cold War history meets Europe's most vibrant contemporary art scene; Munich where Bavarian beer halls and world-class museums share the city with an English Garden bigger than Central Park; and the Bavarian Alps where Neuschwanstein Castle — the fairy-tale castle that inspired Disneyland — floats above a pristine Alpine lake.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Berlin
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel in Mitte. Evening walk on Unter den Linden. Berlin Welcome dinner with a local.

itinerary.title: Berlin: History & Art
itinerary.description: Brandenburg Gate. Reichstag glass dome (pre-book). Holocaust Memorial. Checkpoint Charlie and the Topography of Terror. East Side Gallery — the largest remaining section of the Berlin Wall. Afternoon museum island and the Pergamon Museum.

itinerary.title: Berlin: Culture & Food
itinerary.description: Kreuzberg neighbourhood — multicultural food market at Markthalle Neun. Potsdamer Platz. Street art tour of Prenzlauer Berg and Friedrichshain. Optional: KaDeWe luxury department store.

itinerary.title: Flight to Munich
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Munich. Marienplatz and the Glockenspiel. Englischer Garten (bigger than Central Park). Hofbräuhaus for a traditional Bavarian lunch. Residenz Palace. Evening in the Schwabing district.

itinerary.title: Neuschwanstein Castle
itinerary.description: Full day at Neuschwanstein Castle in the Bavarian Alps — the fairy-tale castle that inspired Sleeping Beauty's castle. Guided interior tour. Alpsee lake walk and Hohenschwangau Castle.

itinerary.title: Munich & Dachau
itinerary.description: Morning at Nymphenburg Palace. Optional: Dachau Memorial. Evening farewell Bavarian dinner — pork knuckle, pretzels and weissbeer.

itinerary.title: Departure from Munich
itinerary.description: Morning free. Transfer to Munich Airport. Departure.

packages.title: Belgium: Bruges, Brussels & Belgian Delights
packages.subtitle: Medieval Canals & Chocolate Heaven
packages.short_description: UNESCO old towns, world-class beer & the best chocolate on Earth
packages.description: Belgium is Europe's most underrated gem — a compact country where every city is a UNESCO treasure. Bruges' medieval canal network is so perfectly preserved it looks like a film set. Brussels' Grand Place is one of the world's most beautiful squares. Ghent's vibrant student scene and dramatic Gravensteen castle complete a picture of a country that punches far above its weight in culture, architecture, and — most importantly — food.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Brussels
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel near Grand Place. Evening at the Grand Place (UNESCO) — the most ornate square in Europe. Manneken Pis. Belgian waffle and beer tasting walk through Ilot Sacré.

itinerary.title: Brussels: Museums & Chocolate
itinerary.description: Royal Museums of Fine Arts (Bruegel and Magritte). Atomium — Brussels' futuristic landmark. Belgian Comic Strip Centre. Afternoon: Chocolate Academy visit and praline-making workshop. Evening in the European Quarter.

itinerary.title: Bruges
itinerary.description: Full day in Bruges — UNESCO World Heritage city. Canal boat tour. Belfry Tower climb (366 steps) for rooftop views. Basilica of the Holy Blood. Brewery De Halve Maan tour. Chocolate and lace shopping on Wollestraat.

itinerary.title: Ghent
itinerary.description: Ghent's Gravensteen Castle. Saint Bavo's Cathedral with the Van Eyck Ghent Altarpiece (one of the world's greatest paintings). Ghent's vibrant Graffiti Street. Evening canal walk and local jenever (gin) tasting.

itinerary.title: Brussels & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free — Sablon antique market, Marolles flea market. Afternoon transfer to Brussels Airport. Departure.

packages.title: Kazakhstan: Almaty, Charyn Canyon & Tian Shan
packages.subtitle: Central Asia's Crown Jewel
packages.short_description: Silk Road city, Grand Canyon rival & soaring Tian Shan peaks
packages.description: Kazakhstan is Central Asia's most accessible and dramatic frontier destination. Almaty sits beneath the soaring snow-capped Tian Shan mountains, and within an hour's drive you can be riding a cable car to alpine meadows or hiking through gorges to turquoise glacial lakes. The Charyn Canyon — Central Asia's answer to the Grand Canyon — stretches for 90km of dramatic red-rock formations, and the ancient Silk Road caravanserais hint at the great trading civilisations that once passed through this land.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Almaty
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel in central Almaty. Evening at Panfilov Park and Zenkov Cathedral — one of the world's tallest wooden buildings. Welcome dinner at a traditional Kazakh yurt restaurant.

itinerary.title: Almaty City & Shymbulak
itinerary.description: Central State Museum. Green Bazaar — the region's most vibrant covered market (dried fruits, kumiss, horsemeat). Cable car to Shymbulak Alpine Resort (2,500m) for panoramic Tian Shan views. Medeu speed-skating rink (highest in the world at 1,691m).

itinerary.title: Charyn Canyon
itinerary.description: Full-day 4WD trip to Charyn Canyon — the Valley of Castles with its extraordinary red-rock formations. Hike through the canyon floor. Lunch at a canyon-side camp. Return via the Ash Tree Grove.

itinerary.title: Big Almaty Lake & Kok Tobe
itinerary.description: Morning hike to the stunning turquoise Big Almaty Lake surrounded by glaciated peaks. Afternoon at Kok Tobe hill — cable car, panoramic views, and traditional amusements. Evening farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at Almaty's Arasan thermal baths (optional). Transfer to airport. Departure.

exclusions: Kazakhstan e-Visa (Indian passport — apply online, ₹1,500 approx.)

packages.title: Mongolia: Gobi Desert & Nomadic Steppes
packages.subtitle: The Last Great Wilderness
packages.short_description: Ger camps, Genghis Khan's legacy & endless golden steppes
packages.description: Mongolia is the last great wilderness — a country of boundless steppes, the legendary Gobi Desert, ancient volcanic landscapes, and a nomadic culture unchanged for centuries. Stay in a traditional ger camp with a herder family, ride Mongolian horses across open grassland under skies more densely star-packed than almost anywhere on Earth, explore the Flaming Cliffs where Roy Chapman Andrews discovered dinosaur eggs, and discover the legacy of Genghis Khan's world-conquering empire.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ulaanbaatar
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel in Ulaanbaatar. Afternoon at the National Museum of Mongolia — 40,000 years of nomadic history. Evening cultural show of traditional music and contortion.

itinerary.title: Ulaanbaatar & Terelj
itinerary.description: Gandantegchinlen Monastery — Mongolia's most sacred Buddhist site. Afternoon at Terelj National Park — Turtle Rock, Ariyabal Meditation Temple, and first ger camp experience. Mongolian BBQ dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Fly to the Gobi
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Dalanzadgad. 4WD transfer to Gobi ger camp. Afternoon camel trek through the dunes. Sunset from the Khongoryn Els sand dunes (longest in Mongolia, up to 300m high).

itinerary.title: Flaming Cliffs & Eagle Valley
itinerary.description: Bayanzag Flaming Cliffs — where Roy Chapman Andrews discovered the first nest of dinosaur eggs in 1922. Yolyn Am (Eagle Valley) — a dramatic gorge with year-round ice in the Gobi. Saxaul forest.

itinerary.title: Nomad Family Stay
itinerary.description: Visit a nomadic herder family — join them for the day: milking goats, learning to make aaruul (dried cheese), and trying archery and wrestling (Mongolian national sports). Dinner and overnight in a genuine family ger.

itinerary.title: Khustai National Park
itinerary.description: Return to Ulaanbaatar via Khustai Nuruu National Park — home to the world's last surviving truly wild horses (Przewalski's). Farewell dinner in Ulaanbaatar.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning free. Transfer to Chinggis Khaan International Airport. Departure.

inclusions: 6 nights (UB hotel 2N, Gobi ger camp 3N, nomad family ger 1N)
Gobi 4WD tours (Flaming Cliffs, Yolyn Am, Khongoryn Els)
exclusions: Mongolia e-Visa (Indian passport — apply online, ₹2,000 approx.)

packages.title: Russia: Moscow & St. Petersburg
packages.subtitle: Imperial Grandeur of the Tsars
packages.short_description: Kremlin, Hermitage, Bolshoi Ballet & Trans-Siberian Railway
packages.description: Russia is a country of breathtaking scale and imperial opulence — where golden-domed cathedrals rise above fortress walls, and world-class art museums house three million masterpieces. Moscow's Red Square and the Kremlin are among the world's most powerful historic images, while St. Petersburg's Hermitage Museum rivals the Louvre, and the Mariinsky Ballet is the world standard. This 7-day journey between Russia's two great capitals delivers the imperial grandeur of the Tsars in extraordinary depth.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Moscow
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel near the Kremlin. Evening walk on Red Square — St Basil's Cathedral illuminated at night is one of the world's great sights. Welcome dinner at a traditional Russian restaurant.

itinerary.title: Moscow Kremlin & Red Square
itinerary.description: Guided Kremlin tour — Cathedral Square, the Armoury Chamber (Fabergé eggs, royal carriages, tsarist regalia). Lenin's Mausoleum. GUM department store arcade. Afternoon at Gorky Park. Bolshoi Theatre evening performance (optional, pre-book).

itinerary.title: Moscow Cultural Day
itinerary.description: Tretyakov Gallery — Russia's greatest collection of national art including iconic Russian Orthodox icons. Moscow Metro Art Tour — the world's most beautiful underground stations (marble chandeliers, mosaics, socialist realist frescoes). Evening at the Arbat pedestrian street.

itinerary.title: High-Speed Train to St. Petersburg
itinerary.description: Sapsan high-speed train (3.5 hrs) to St. Petersburg. Afternoon on Nevsky Prospekt — the city's grand main boulevard. Evening at the Church on Spilled Blood and Mikhailovsky Garden.

itinerary.title: The Hermitage Museum
itinerary.description: Full day at the State Hermitage Museum — 3 million artworks across the Winter Palace and five buildings. Da Vinci, Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Monet, Picasso. Palace Square and Alexander Column. Evening White Nights canal boat tour (summer only — the sun barely sets).

itinerary.title: Peterhof & Catherine's Palace
itinerary.description: Morning boat to Peterhof Palace — the "Russian Versailles" with 150 fountains and golden statues. Afternoon at Tsarskoe Selo — Catherine's Palace with the legendary Amber Room (an entire room panelled in amber, gold leaf, and mirrors). Farewell dinner on the Neva River.

itinerary.title: Departure from St. Petersburg
itinerary.description: Morning free. Transfer to Pulkovo Airport. Departure.

inclusions: Full Kremlin guided tour + Armoury Chamber
exclusions: Russian visa (₹6,000 approx., requires invitation letter — provided)

packages.title: Luxembourg & Vianden Castle Explorer
packages.subtitle: Europe's Hidden Grand Duchy
packages.short_description: UNESCO fortresses, Moselle wines & the Ardennes forest
packages.description: Luxembourg is Europe's most surprising secret — a tiny grand duchy where medieval hilltop fortresses loom over dramatic river gorges, UNESCO-listed old city ramparts shelter cosmopolitan streets below, and the Moselle Valley's sun-drenched vineyards produce some of the region's most delicate white wines. Most visitors pass through on a European circuit without stopping — those who do stop discover one of the continent's most rewarding hidden gems. Best combined with Belgium or Germany as part of a wider Benelux itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Luxembourg City
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel. Explore the Bock Casemates — 17km of underground rock-hewn fortification tunnels (UNESCO). Chemin de la Corniche — the "most beautiful balcony in Europe" overlooking the Alzette gorge and the Grund district below. Welcome dinner in the Grand Duchy.

itinerary.title: Vianden Castle & Müllerthal
itinerary.description: Drive to Vianden — the fairy-tale castle above the Our River, one of Europe's most romantic medieval fortresses. Victor Hugo's house in Vianden. Afternoon in Müllerthal ("Little Switzerland") — the dramatic sandstone gorge trail through mossy boulders and waterfalls. Return to Luxembourg City.

itinerary.title: Moselle Valley & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning drive along the Moselle Valley — rolling vineyards, ornate wine villages, and tasting at a Crémant de Luxembourg producer. Afternoon departure.

inclusions: 2 nights in Luxembourg City boutique hotel
exclusions: International flights (usually combined with Belgium/Germany package)
